scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh, I guess all is going well for you. So how has everything else been?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
哦，看來你一切都好。那其他事情呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I may be being overly sensitive, but it feels like something might happen soon. Aaah, don't mind me. It's no big deal. Maybe I'm just being weird.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我可能有點過於敏感了，但感覺最近會發生什麼事。啊，別在意我。沒什麼大不了的。也許我只是有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Right, right, let me play a song for you. Would you care to listen?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
對了，讓我為你演奏一首曲子吧。你想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, why not~
scripts.translation: 好啊，為什麼不呢~

scripts.text: How about some news?
scripts.translation: 有什麼新聞嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, which song
would you like to hear?
Go ahead, pick one~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
那麼，你想聽哪首歌呢？
請隨意挑選~

scripts.text: Bragi's Poem
scripts.translation: 布拉吉的詩篇

scripts.text: Eternal Chaos
scripts.translation: 永恆的混沌

scripts.text: Assassin in the Sunset
scripts.translation: 夕陽下的刺客

scripts.text: Der Ring des Nibelungen
scripts.translation: 尼伯龍根的指環

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Bragi's Poem!
What a good choice!
I must say this song
represents the
heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
布拉吉的詩篇！
真是好選擇！
不得不說，這首歌代表了詩人的心！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Eternal Chaos...
Sounds too chaotic.
By the way, I wonder
what the title really
means. Is it the chaos
of hell or our own reality?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
永恆的混沌...
聽起來太混亂了。
順便問一下，我不明白標題到底是什麼意思。是地獄的混沌，還是我們現實的混沌？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Assassin in the Sunset!
Yes, no one looks cooler than an Assassin, the bringer of death, standing alone in the sunset! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
夕陽下的刺客！
沒錯，沒有人比刺客更酷了，這位死亡使者，獨自站在夕陽下！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Der Ring des Nibelungen.....
Okay, are you ready to listen?
Hum hum hum....
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
尼伯龍根的指環.....
好了，你準備好聽了嗎？
哼...哼...哼....

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFRheingold...
Hidden in the Rhein river.
If made into a ring,
Could rule the world~^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF萊茵黃金...
藏於萊茵河中。
若鑄成指環，
便可統治世界~^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFProtected by a spell
Cursing its thief
To never find love.
Alberich had known
Nonetheless stole it.
Love was forsaken for power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF它受咒語守護，
詛咒竊取者
永遠得不到愛情。
阿爾貝里希明知如此，
仍將它偷走。
為了權力，他捨棄了愛情。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFGiants built beautiful Valhalla
Matrimony with Freya
Goddess of beauty
Their supposed payment.
In not receiving it
They forcefully took her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF巨人建造了美麗的瓦爾哈拉，
約定的報酬
是與美之女神芙蕾雅成婚。
未能如願，
他們便強行將她擄走。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFThe gods would
give Alberich's treasure
To the Giants for Freya's return.
Loki tricked Alberich,
Stealing his ring or power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF眾神決定
將阿爾貝里希的寶藏
交給巨人，換回芙蕾雅。
洛基騙過阿爾貝里希，
奪走了他的力量之戒。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFBut Alberich cursed his ring
Before it was returned to him,
Envy and death would
befall its wearers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF但在指環交出之前，
阿爾貝里希詛咒了它：
嫉妒與死亡
將降臨於佩戴者。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFThe ring was given to the giants
Freya was returned to the gods
The giants killed themselves
Fighting over the rheingold,
Victims of Alberich's curse~^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF指環交給了巨人，
芙蕾雅回到了眾神身邊。
巨人們為爭奪萊茵黃金
自相殘殺，
成了阿爾貝里希詛咒的犧牲品~^000000

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Some news you say..
What kind of news do
you wish to hear about?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你想聽些新聞？
你想聽哪方面的訊息呢？

scripts.text: About Prontera!
scripts.translation: 關於普隆德拉！

scripts.text: About coastal areas.
scripts.translation: 關於沿海地區

scripts.text: Is the desert still hot?
scripts.translation: 沙漠還是很熱嗎？

scripts.text: How about the borderlands?
scripts.translation: 邊境地區怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What?! Prontera?!
Can you not see that the front
gate of Prontera is right before you? You should at least know where you are, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
什麼？！普隆德拉？！
你沒看到普隆德拉的正門就在你面前嗎？
冒險者，你至少該知道自己在哪吧。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyways, I have one interesting news about Prontera. But, it's a secret. Shh! Are you... Single?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
總之，我有一條關於普隆德拉的有趣訊息。
不過，這是個秘密。噓！你...是單身嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, go visit the tavern. I met a guy there who took to me a nice place. Oh yes. He took me to 'the place' where singles are forbidden~!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
如果是的話，去酒館看看吧。
我在那裡遇到了一個傢伙，他帶我去了一處不錯的地方。
哦對了。他帶我去的是“單身禁止入內”的地方~！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Coastal areas?
That's a funny question. I mean, there's Alberta and a few other places where you can see the sea.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
沿海地區？
這問題真有趣。我是說，艾爾貝塔和其他幾個地方都能看到海。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
To the southwest there's
Kokomo Beach. But, I suppose it's too dangerous just to go there to take a stroll.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
西南方有剋剋魔海邊。
不過，我覺得光是去那裡散步就太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Kokomo Beach is a large
expanse of sand. The nearby water is filled with sea animals, so you can enjoy catching Shellfishes.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
剋剋魔海邊是一大片沙灘。
附近的水域裡充滿了海洋生物，所以你可以盡情捕捉貝類。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, there are always bullies in that kind of place. Once, I met a threatening looking hoodlum with red spiky hair.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
不過，那種地方總是會有惡霸。
有一次，我遇到了一個長相兇惡、紅髮豎立的混混。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
He was chewing on something and spat it on the ground. The big buffoon managed to intimidate me into giving him all of my Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
他嘴裡嚼著什麼東西，然後吐在地上。
那個大塊頭竟然嚇唬我，讓我把身上的Zeny全交給他！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This world is too
dangerous for a young
and fragile Bard.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
這個世界對年輕脆弱的詩人來說太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
By the way, Alberta doesn't seem to have changed. The Sunken Ship looks the same as well, with all of its Skeleton Pirates and whatnot. You know how it is.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
順便說一句，艾爾貝塔似乎沒什麼變化。
沉船也一樣，到處都是邪骸海盜什麼的。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The event agency in charge of expeditions into the Sunken Ship is still making tons of money. If you have nothing to do, why don't you hunt for monsters down there?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
負責沉船探險活動的機構依然賺得盆滿缽滿。
如果你沒事做，為什麼不去下面打打魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh, hell yes!
When is it not?
The desert is hot, has
been hot and probably
always will be...!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
噢，天哪！
什麼時候不熱？
沙漠很熱，一直很熱，可能永遠都會這麼熱...！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Giant worms still jump out of nowhere, freaking out innocent travellers like myself, and the Sandmen still kick people in the, well... You know where.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
巨大的蟲子還是會從不知哪裡跳出來，嚇壞像我這樣無辜的旅行者，而且沙人還是會踢人的...嗯...你知道哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even if the desert is filled with hideous monsters, the view of the ocean there is so magnificent. Hah, it makes me want to play a song.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
即使沙漠裡充滿了醜陋的魔物，那裡的海景卻非常壯麗。
哈哈，讓我想彈一首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I must say there is
one place you may wish
to see in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我必須說，沙漠裡有一個地方你可能想去看看。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
But you should know what I am talking about! So when are you gonna take me to the guild, eh?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我說的是刺客公會。據說它隱藏在夢羅克的沙塵暴後面！
你應該知道我在說什麼吧！所以，你什麼時候帶我去公會看看呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
Have you ever been there before?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我說的是刺客公會。據說它隱藏在夢羅克的沙塵暴後面！
你以前去過那裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, to the north is the Schwaltzwald Republic.
There, you'll find Juno,
the 'City of Sages.'
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯，往北是修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國。
在那裡，你會找到朱諾，也就是“賢者之城”。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The people there say that there is one major nuisance, a man known as
the 'Mad Scientist.' He's antisocial and creates a lot of public disturbances with his experiments.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
那裡的人說，有一個大麻煩，一個被稱為“瘋狂科學家”的男人。他性格孤僻，他的實驗經常造成公共騷亂。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It seems everyone in Juno
hates him with a passion. Even one of the Tool Shop owners begged a passing adventurer to stop this Mad Scientist's research!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
看來朱諾的每個人都非常討厭他。甚至有一位工具店的店主懇求路過的冒險者阻止這個瘋狂科學家的研究！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I have a different opinion about him. I believe it's not a good idea to interrupt the work of any scientist.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但對他，我有不同的看法。我認為打斷任何科學家的研究都不是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
After all, he might just discover something important, even if his experiments are a little hazardous.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
畢竟，即使他的實驗有點危險，他可能也會發現一些重要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Speaking of discoveries, you know how Juno floats in the air, right?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
說到發現，你知道朱諾是漂浮在空中的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's said that a piece of Ymir's Heart generates enough power
to keep the entire city aloft in the sky. Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
據說一塊尤彌爾之心產生的能量足以讓整座城市懸浮在天空中。這不是很神奇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even more recent is the news about the discovery of Ymir's Book. You can read it in Juno's Sage Castle. I hear that it contains the secret to meeting Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
更近的訊息是關於尤彌爾之書的發現。你可以在朱諾的賢者城堡裡閱讀它。我聽說它包含了遇見瓦爾基里的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Huh? Okay then, talk to you later. May Bragi bless you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯？好吧，那下次再聊。願布拉吉保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, have you
met Mr. Kaili?
Please do your best.
After all, I especially
recommended you~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
那麼，你見過凱利先生了嗎？
請加油。
畢竟，我特別推薦了你哦~

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事

scripts.text: Sing a song for me.
scripts.translation: 為我唱首歌

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hmm. What would
be a good story for
you this time...? Ah yes, I've got it. Let me tell you about one of my own adventures. It was a pretty amazing experience.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯。這次給你講個什麼故事好呢...？啊，有了。讓我給你講講我自己的冒險經歷。那是一次相當驚人的體驗。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I went to Morocc, the city of the desert. On my way there, I became exhausted from the heat. Luckily, I found a hole beneath the shadows and climbed in to rest.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我去了沙漠之城夢羅克。在去的路上，我熱得精疲力竭。幸運的是，我在陰影下發現了一個洞，爬進去休息。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh my God...
If I had known
better, I would have
never gone inside that place...
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
天哪...
如果我知道更多，我絕不會進入那個地方...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I actually crawled into the infamous ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000! I don't sound like a coward to you, do I?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我實際上爬進了臭名昭著的^FF0000螞蟻地獄^000000！你不覺得我是個膽小鬼吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, the ants aren't the only ones living there. I wasn't afraid of them at all. Except, of course, when they attacked in groups.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯，那裡住著的不僅僅是螞蟻。我一點也不怕它們。當然，除非它們成群結隊地攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What I was really afraid of was this type of strawberry colored... tongue thing. Phreeoni!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我真正害怕的是這種草莓色的...舌頭狀的東西。皮裡恩！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Fortunately, I survived the whole incident, although I still have nightmares of that man-sized tongue.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
幸運的是，我在那次事件中活了下來，儘管我仍然會夢到那個男人那麼大的舌頭。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Once I got out of there, I craved human companionship to restore my sense of normalcy. The closest place that I knew was Paros Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
從那裡出來後，我渴望人類的陪伴，以恢復我的正常感。我所知道的最接近的地方是帕羅斯燈塔。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Yet again, I decided to traverse the desert, despite the fact that the Kafra Ladies provide a very convenient teleport service there.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
儘管如此，我還是決定穿越沙漠，儘管卡普拉女士們在那裡提供了非常方便的傳送服務。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyway, the fortress of Sandaruman is on the way to Paros Lighthouse. I remember Serutero, a guy I met in south Morocc, telling me about its scenic beauty.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
總之，桑達魯曼要塞就在去帕羅斯燈塔的路上。我記得在南夢羅克遇到的塞魯特羅曾告訴我那裡風景優美。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was so excited
about seeing it
for myself. After all, doesn't 'Sandaruman' sound like the
name of a beautiful place?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我對自己能親眼看到它感到興奮。畢竟，“桑達魯曼”聽起來不像是個美麗的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I immediately regretted my decision once I arrived. Of course, the view was breathtaking: the sandy hills near the ocean, as
well as the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但當我到達那裡時，我立刻後悔了自己的決定。當然，景色令人歎為觀止：海邊的沙丘，以及廢墟。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And of course I forgot Serutero's warning about all the monsters. Argh! It was a nightmare! Instead of enjoying the scenary, I ended up running for my life.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
當然，我忘記了塞魯特羅關於那裡所有魔物的警告。啊！那簡直是場夢魘！我沒有欣賞風景，而是拼命逃命。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was still trying to escape those monsters when I stumbled upon
an old house, West of Sandaruman, that seemed to be in a state of decay.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我還在試圖逃離那些魔物時，撞上了桑達魯曼西邊的一座舊房子，看起來已經破敗不堪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I recalled that Serutero said that no one was living in that area, so I began to worry a bit. Still, I was desperate and needed refuge.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我記得塞魯特羅說過那個地區沒有人居住，所以我開始有點擔心。不過，我走投無路，需要避難。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In my panic, I violently knocked on the door and screamed for someone to let me inside. Then do you know what I heard?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
在驚慌中，我用力敲門，大喊讓人讓我進去。然後你猜我聽到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^FF0000Who's there?!
Who would dare to intrude
upon my territory?^000000
I was freaked out! Whoever owned that house must have been some
kind of lunatic!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
^FF0000誰在那裡？！
誰敢闖入我的領地？^000000
我嚇壞了！那個房子的主人一定是個瘋子！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Th-then, with the specter of Death nipping at my heels, he told me to get lost! Luckily, I was saved by a mysterious, wandering SuperNovice, but that's another story.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
然後，在死亡的陰影緊追不捨的情況下，他讓我滾開！幸運的是，我被一個神秘的流浪超級初心者救了，但那是另一個故事了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In any case, I finally arrived at Paros Lighthouse. There, I learned that the old house was a secret camp for the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
無論如何，我終於到達了帕羅斯燈塔。在那裡，我得知那座舊房子是流氓公會的秘密營地。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's amazing, how they can live in such dangerous areas. Only Rogues would be able to survive there, you know?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
真不可思議，他們竟然能住在這麼危險的地方。只有流氓才能在那裡生存，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah...
I'm so tired from talking so much. But if I happen to have another adventure, I shall share that tale with you.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
啊...
說了這麼多，我好累。但如果我還有下一次冒險，我會把那個故事講給你聽。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, you wish
to hear a song?
Okay! I shall then
perform my favorite.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
啊，你想聽一首歌？
好的！那我表演我最喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我追逐名聲，
它卻離我而去。
我追尋幸福，
卻從未將它握住。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但明天
依然會到來，我確信。
就像艾爾帕蘭的水車，
隨著生活繼續
而不停轉動。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
振作起來！生活還在繼續。
只要水車還在轉動，
明天就一定會到來。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Say...
Have we met before?
Hmm? Never? Well...
That's rather odd.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
說...
我們以前見過嗎？
嗯？沒有？那...
這有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I seem to recall that you've asked me to give you some information if I ever have any. Well, now I have and shall share it with you~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我似乎記得你曾讓我如果有資訊就分享給你。現在我有資訊了，會分享給你~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The usefulness of this information all depends on you. Now, have you heard of the ^3333CCMonster Research Organization^000000?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
這些資訊是否有用，全看你自己了。那麼，你聽說過^3333CC魔物研究組織^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I happened to get this information from its headquarters in Juno. So how does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我剛好從位於朱諾的總部得到了這些資訊。聽起來怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Wee~ I want to hear!
scripts.translation: 哇~ 我想聽！

scripts.text: Booooring~
scripts.translation: 好無聊~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well...!
You seem to be
very excited about
this new tidbit of
knowledge I have~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
哎呀...
看來你對這個新訊息非常感興趣呢~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Alas, this information doesn't seem to be very valuable to someone such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
唉，看來這些資訊對你這樣的人來說，並沒有太大的價值。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm so very sorry to have excited you, but only people that are strong enough to handle grueling work can benefit from this.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
很抱歉讓你興奮了，但只有足夠強大、能勝任艱鉅工作的人，才能從中受益。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Why don't you travel around and gain more experiences? I will let you know when you're ready, you know~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
不如你四處旅行，多積累一些經驗吧？等你準備好了，我會告訴你的~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ooh...
And you look
like you can handle
this kind of information.
I'll share everything I know!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
噢...
看來你能處理這類資訊。
我會把我知道的都告訴你！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
One day, an adventurer discovered a strange, mysterious object. Unable to figure out what it could do, he visited the Monster Organization.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
有一天，一位冒險者發現了一個奇怪而神秘的物品。由於無法弄清它的用途，他拜訪了魔物研究組織。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
There, it was entrusted to a scholar by the name of Mr. Kaili. He still hasn't uncovered the truth about that item and wishes for assistance in his investigation.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
在那裡，該物品被託付給了一位名叫凱利的學者。他至今仍未揭開該物品的真相，並希望得到協助進行調查。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Mr. Kaili suspects that the item might be part of an undiscovered ancient relic. Fortunately, he is also researching ancient relics as a project assigned by the royal court.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
凱利先生懷疑該物品可能是某個未被發現的古代遺蹟的一部分。幸運的是，他也正在研究古代遺蹟，這是王室指派給他的專案。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So what do you think? Isn't that interesting? Of course, you'd better speak to Mr. Kaili if you wish to learn more. If you'd like, I shall write you a letter or recommendation.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你覺得怎麼樣？是不是很有趣？當然，如果你想了解更多，最好去和凱利先生對話。如果你願意，我可以為你寫一封介紹信。

scripts.text: Sure! Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 當然！聽起來不錯

scripts.text: Sorry, I am not that interested.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒那麼感興趣

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Excellent...!
So your name is...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
太好了...
那麼你的名字是...
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Alright, I shall contact him right away! Oh, and you can find the Monster Organization west of Juno's central plaza. It shouldn't be hard to find. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
好的，我會立刻聯絡他！哦，你可以在朱諾中央廣場的西側找到魔物研究組織。應該不難找。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, it's disappointing to hear that. I thought that you'd be perfect to help out Mr. Kaili. Oh well, talk to you later~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
啊，聽到這話真讓人失望。我以為你很適合幫助凱利先生。算了，下次再聊吧~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Boring, you say?
Perhaps, but not as
boring as an adventurer
that passes up a chance
for an adventure, yes?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
無聊，是嗎？
也許吧，但這並不比一個放棄冒險機會的冒險者更無聊，對吧？

scripts.text: Tell me a story.
scripts.translation: 給我講個故事

scripts.text: Sing a song for me.
scripts.translation: 為我唱首歌

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hmm. What would
be a good story for
you this time...? Ah yes, I've got it. Let me tell you about one of my own adventures. It was a pretty amazing experience.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯。這次給你講個什麼故事好呢...？啊，有了。讓我給你講講我自己的冒險經歷。那是一次相當驚人的體驗。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I went to Morocc, the city of the desert. On my way there, I became exhausted from the heat. Luckily, I found a hole beneath the shadows and climbed in to rest.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我去了沙漠之城夢羅克。在去的路上，我熱得精疲力竭。幸運的是，我在陰影下發現了一個洞，爬進去休息。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh my God...
If I had known
better, I never
would have gone
inside that place...
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
天哪...
如果我知道後果，我絕不會進入那個地方...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I actually crawled into the infamous ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000! I don't sound like a coward to you, do I?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我實際上爬進了臭名昭著的^FF0000螞蟻地獄^000000！你不覺得我是個膽小鬼吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, the ants aren't the only ones living there. I wasn't afraid of them at all. Except, of course, when they attacked in groups.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯，那裡住著的不僅僅是螞蟻。我一點也不怕它們。當然，除非它們成群結隊地攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What I was really afraid of was this type of strawberry colored... tongue thing. Phreeoni!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我真正害怕的是這種草莓色的...舌頭狀的東西。皮裡恩！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Fortunately, I survived the whole incident, although I still have nightmares of that man-sized tongue.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
幸運的是，我在那次事件中活了下來，儘管我仍然會夢到那個男人那麼大的舌頭。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Once I got out of there, I craved human companionship to restore my sense of normalcy. The closest place that I knew was Paros Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
從那裡出來後，我渴望人類的陪伴，以恢復我的正常感。我所知道的最接近的地方是帕羅斯燈塔。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Yet again, I decided to traverse the desert, despite the fact that the Kafra Ladies provide a very convenient teleport service there.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
儘管如此，我還是決定穿越沙漠，儘管卡普拉女士們在那裡提供了非常方便的傳送服務。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyway, the fortress of Sandaruman is on the way to Paros Lighthouse. I remember Serutero, a guy I met in south Morocc, telling me about its scenic beauty.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
總之，桑達魯曼要塞就在去帕羅斯燈塔的路上。我記得在南夢羅克遇到的塞魯特羅曾告訴我那裡風景優美。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was so excited
about seeing it
for myself. After all, doesn't 'Sandaruman' sound like the
name of a beautiful place?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我對自己能親眼看到它感到興奮。畢竟，“桑達魯曼”聽起來不像是個美麗的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I immediately regretted my decision once I arrived. Of course, the view was breathtaking: the sandy hills near the ocean, as
well as the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但當我到達那裡時，我立刻後悔了自己的決定。當然，景色令人歎為觀止：海邊的沙丘，以及廢墟。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And of course I forgot Serutero's warning about all the monsters. Argh! It was a nightmare! Instead of enjoying the scenary, I ended up running for my life.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
當然，我忘記了塞魯特羅關於那裡所有魔物的警告。啊！那簡直是場夢魘！我沒有欣賞風景，而是拼命逃命。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I was still trying to escape those monsters when I stumbled upon
an old house, West of Sandaruman, that seemed to be in a state of decay.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我還在試圖逃離那些魔物時，撞上了桑達魯曼西邊的一座舊房子，看起來已經破敗不堪。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I recalled that Serutero said that no one was living in that area, so I began to worry a bit. Still, I was desperate and needed refuge.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我記得塞魯特羅說過那個地區沒有人居住，所以我開始有點擔心。不過，我走投無路，需要避難。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In my panic, I violently knocked on the door and screamed for someone to let me inside. Then do you know what I heard?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
在驚慌中，我用力敲門，大喊讓人讓我進去。然後你猜我聽到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^FF0000Who's there?!
Who would dare to intrude
upon my territory?^000000
I was freaked out! Whoever owned that house must have been some
kind of lunatic!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
^FF0000誰在那裡？！
誰敢闖入我的領地？^000000
我嚇壞了！那個房子的主人一定是個瘋子！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Th-then, with the specter of Death nipping at my heels, he told me to get lost! Luckily, I was saved by a mysterious, wandering SuperNovice, but that's another story.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
然後，在死亡的陰影緊追不捨的情況下，他讓我滾開！幸運的是，我被一個神秘的流浪超級初心者救了，但那是另一個故事了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
In any case, I finally arrived at Paros Lighthouse. There, I learned that the old house was a secret camp for the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
無論如何，我終於到達了帕羅斯燈塔。在那裡，我得知那座舊房子是流氓公會的秘密營地。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's amazing, how they can live in such dangerous areas. Only Rogues would be able to survive there, you know?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
真不可思議，他們竟然能住在這麼危險的地方。只有流氓才能在那裡生存，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah...
I'm so tired from talking so much. But if I happen to have another adventure, I shall share that tale with you.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
啊...
說了這麼多，我好累。但如果我還有下一次冒險，我會把那個故事講給你聽。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Ah, you wish
to hear a song?
Okay! I shall then
perform my favorite.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
啊，你想聽一首歌？
好的！那我表演我最喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我追逐名聲，
它卻離我而去。
我追尋幸福，
卻從未將它握住。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但明天
依然會到來，我確信。
就像艾爾帕蘭的水車，
隨著生活繼續
而不停轉動。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
振作起來！生活還在繼續。
只要水車還在轉動，
明天就一定會到來。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hello there!
Isn't it such
a glorious day?
You know of me,
do you not?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你好呀！
今天真是個好天氣呢！
你認識我，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Hahahaha, forgive my rudeness,
but I fail to remember your name, although your face does seem rather familiar.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
哈哈哈哈哈，抱歉失禮了，雖然你的臉看起來很熟悉，但我實在想不起你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh well well...
How could I ever
forget the lovely
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
哎呀哎呀...
我怎麼可能忘記可愛的{0}呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
So, aren't you curious about me? Feel free to ask me whatever you like! I'm the vagabond that will wander the earth till the end of his days, your friend who loves to sing under the moonlight~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
那麼，你不好奇我嗎？儘管問吧！我是那個將流浪至生命盡頭的流浪者，也是喜歡在月光下歌唱的朋友~

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: What's new?
scripts.translation: 有什麼新鮮事？

scripts.text: Can you sing?
scripts.translation: 你會唱歌嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Why, I am Nelliorde, the Bard.
In truth, my real name is Elliorde.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我是內利奧德，一名詩人。
其實，我的本名叫艾利奧德。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, while I was singing at a Tavern, as per usual, a man with long blonde hair angrily demanded that I change my name!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
然而，有一次我在酒館唱歌時，一個金髮男子憤怒地要求我改名！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Never before have I seen such a flailing and a fuss over someone coincidentally sharing the same name!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我從未見過有人因為名字巧合而如此大動干戈！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And so, that little altercation
was settled with me being named Nelliorde.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
於是，那場小爭執以我被改名為內利奧德而告終。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I don't sound like a coward to you, do I? Do you believe I should have fought for the right to keep my original name?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你覺得我是個膽小鬼嗎？你認為我應該為保留原名而戰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, you're wrong! I just don't believe that violence can solve anything, as the romantic Bard
that cherishes peace...
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
如果是這樣，那你就錯了！作為一個珍視和平的浪漫詩人，我不相信暴力能解決任何問題...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSeeing as it's not worth
listening to Nelliorde's lies, you decide to simply tune him out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然聽內利奧德撒謊毫無意義，你決定直接無視他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
And that's how I convinced wise
and benevolent King Tristram III to build a paradise where married lovers could enjo--Hm? Are you even listening?!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
就這樣，我成功說服了睿智仁慈的國王特里斯坦三世，建造了一個讓已婚戀人能盡情享--嗯？你在聽嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
You wish to
hear of some news?
What kind of news do
you wish to know about?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你想聽什麼新聞？
你想了解哪方面的訊息？

scripts.text: About Prontera!
scripts.translation: 關於普隆德拉！

scripts.text: About seaside areas.
scripts.translation: 關於海邊地區

scripts.text: Is the desert still hot?
scripts.translation: 沙漠還是很熱嗎？

scripts.text: How about the borderlands?
scripts.translation: 邊境地區怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
What?! Prontera?!
Can you not see that the front
gate of Prontera is right before you? You should at least know where you are, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
什麼？！普隆德拉？！
你沒看到普隆德拉的正門就在你面前嗎？
冒險者，你至少該知道自己在哪吧。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Anyways, I know one interesting bit of news about Prontera. But it's a secret. Shh! Are you... Single?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
總之，我知道一條關於普隆德拉的有趣新聞。但是這是秘密。噓！你是...單身嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
If so, go visit the tavern. I met a guy there who took me a nice place. Oh yes. He took me the place where singles are forbidden~!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
如果是的話，去酒館看看吧。我在那裡遇到一個傢伙，他帶我去了一家不錯的店。哦對了。他帶我去了一家禁止單身者進入的地方~！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Seaside areas?
That's a funny question. I mean, there's Alberta and a few other places where you can see the sea.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
海邊地區？
真是有趣的問題。我是說，艾爾貝塔和其他幾個地方都能看到大海。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
To the southwest there's
Kokomo Beach. But, I suppose it's too dangerous just to go there to take a stroll.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
西南方有剋剋魔海邊。
不過，我覺得光是去那裡散步就太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Kokomo Beach is a large
expanse of sand. The nearby water is filled with sea animals, so you can enjoy catching Shellfishes.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
剋剋魔海邊是一大片沙灘。
附近的水域裡充滿了海洋生物，所以你可以盡情捕捉貝類。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
However, there are always bullies in that kind of place. Once, I met a threatening looking hoodlum with red spiky hair.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
不過，那種地方總是會有惡霸。
有一次，我遇到了一個長相兇惡、紅髮豎立的混混。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
He was chewing on something and spat on the ground. The big buffoon managed to intimidate me into giving him all of my Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
他嘴裡嚼著什麼東西，然後吐在地上。那個大笨蛋竟然用恐嚇的手段，讓我把身上的Zeny全交給了他！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This world is too
dangerous for a young
and fragile Bard.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
這個世界對年輕脆弱的詩人來說太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
By the way, Alberta doesn't seem to have changed. The Sunken Ship looks the same as well, with all of its Skeleton Pirates and whatnot. You know how it is.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
順便說一句，艾爾貝塔似乎沒什麼變化。
沉船也一樣，到處都是邪骸海盜什麼的。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The event agency in charge of expeditions into the Sunken Ship is still making tons of money. If you have nothing to do, why don't you hunt for monsters down there?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
負責沉船探險活動的機構依然賺得盆滿缽滿。
如果你沒事做，為什麼不去下面打打魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Oh yes!
When is it not?
The desert is hot, has
been hot and probably
always will be...!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
哦，是的！
什麼時候不熱呢？
沙漠很熱，一直都很熱，而且大概永遠都會這麼熱...！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Giant worms still jump out of nowhere, freaking out innocent travellers like myself, and the Sandmen still kick people in the, well... You know where.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
巨大的蟲子還是會從不知哪裡跳出來，嚇壞像我這樣無辜的旅行者，而且沙人還是會踢人的...嗯...你知道哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even if the desert is filled with hideous monsters, the view of the ocean there is so magnificent. Hah, it makes me want to play a song.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
即使沙漠裡充滿了醜陋的魔物，那裡的海景卻非常壯麗。
哈哈，讓我想彈一首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I must say there is
one place you may wish
to see in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我必須說，沙漠裡有一個地方你可能想去看看。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc
Desert! But you should know what I am talking about! So when are you gonna take me to the guild, eh?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我說的是刺客公會。據說它隱藏在夢羅克沙漠的沙暴之後！不過你應該知道我在說什麼吧！所以，你什麼時候帶我去公會啊，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc
Desert! Have you ever been there before?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
我說的是刺客公會。據說它隱藏在夢羅克沙漠的沙暴之後！你以前去過那裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Well, to the north is the Schwaltzwald Republic.
There, you'll find Juno,
the 'City of Sages.'
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
嗯，往北是修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國。
在那裡，你會找到朱諾，也就是“賢者之城”。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
The people there say that there is one major nuisance, a man known
as the 'Mad Scientist.' He's antisocial and creates a lot of public disturbances with his experiments.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
那裡的人說，有一個主要的麻煩人物，被稱為“瘋狂科學家”。他性格孤僻，經常因為他的實驗引起公共騷亂。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It seems everyone in Juno hates
him with a passion. Even one of the Tool Shop owners begged a passing adventurer to stop this Mad Scientist's research!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
看來朱諾的每個人都對他恨之入骨。甚至有一位工具店的店主都懇求路過的冒險者去阻止這位瘋狂科學家的研究！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
But I have a different opinion about him. I believe it's not a good idea to interrupt the work of any scientist.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
但對他，我有不同的看法。我認為打斷任何科學家的研究都不是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
After all, he might just discover something important, even if his experiments are a little hazardous.
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
畢竟，即使他的實驗有點危險，他可能也會發現一些重要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Speaking of discoveries, you know how Juno floats in the air, right?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
說到發現，你知道朱諾是漂浮在空中的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
It's said that a piece of Ymir's Heart generates enough power
to keep the entire city aloft in the sky. Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
據說一塊尤彌爾之心產生的能量足以讓整座城市懸浮在天空中。這不是很神奇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Even more recent is the news about the discovery of Ymir's Book. You can read it in Juno's Sage Castle. I hear that it contains the secret to meeting Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
更近的訊息是關於尤彌爾之書的發現。你可以在朱諾的賢者城堡裡閱讀它。我聽說它包含了遇見瓦爾基里的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Can I sing, you ask?
Certainly, and if I may say so, pleasureably. Which song would
you care to hear?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
你想問我能不能唱歌嗎？
當然可以，而且恕我自誇，唱得還挺悅耳的。你想聽哪首歌呢？

scripts.text: Bragi's Poem
scripts.translation: 布拉吉的詩篇

scripts.text: Eternal Chaos
scripts.translation: 永恆的混沌

scripts.text: Assassin in the Sunset
scripts.translation: 夕陽下的刺客

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Bragi's Poem!
What a good choice!
I must say this song
represents the
heart of a poet!
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
布拉吉的詩篇！
真是好選擇！
不得不說，這首歌代表了詩人的心！

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
請原諒我，但我不能免費演奏。世界很殘酷，像我這樣瘦弱的詩人必須得找點辦法生存下去~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
You must like robust
and energetic music, eh?
As you wish~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
看來你喜歡強勁而充滿活力的音樂，是嗎？
如你所願~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
請原諒我，但我不能免費演奏。世界很殘酷，像我這樣瘦弱的詩人必須得找點辦法生存下去~

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Excellent choice!
Somehow, the image of
the setting sun fits
well with Assassins.
Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
極好的選擇！
不知為何，夕陽西下的景象與刺客很相配。
你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nelliorde]
Please forgive me, but I cannot play a song for free. The world is harsh, and a frail Bard such as myself must have some means
to survive~
scripts.translation:
[內利奧德]
請原諒我，但我不能免費演奏。世界很殘酷，像我這樣瘦弱的詩人必須得找點辦法生存下去~

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
Hmmm...
The highest quality Red Potion ever...
scripts.translation:
[研讀中的學者]
嗯...
史上最高品質的紅色藥水...

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
If only I could figure a way to balance the consistency of the ground Red Herbs mixed with the water. That part is most crucial...
scripts.translation:
[研讀中的學者]
要是我能找到一種方法，平衡研磨後的紅色藥草與水的比例就好了。那部分是最關鍵的...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, {0},
you've returned.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
啊，{0}，你回來了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Learning about Brisingamen was truly fascinating. But since we've hit a plateau for now, I've started a new research project.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
研究女神項鍊真的非常迷人。但既然我們現在遇到了瓶頸，我就開始了一個新的研究專案。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hahahaha~
I'm sorry, but I cannot tell you about it for now, since it's confidential. But once I get a chance, I'll ask you for help.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哈哈哈~
抱歉，現在還不能告訴你，因為這是機密。但一旦有機會，我會請你幫忙的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, I see. So it's true that Berling sealed himself in the ripple where the goddess' tear
fell into the waters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
啊，我明白了。所以是真的，貝林將自己封印在女神之淚落入水中的漣漪之中。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh! I'm so excited! I don't know what to do first! Should I report to His Majesty or publish my findings or...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哦！我太激動了！我不知道該先做什麼！是向陛下彙報，還是發表我的研究成果，還是...

scripts.text: ^333333*Ahem!*^000000 My reward!

[Enrico Kaili]
Oh, right.
Thank you for all the trouble you have endured for my sake. You are truly one of the best researchers I've ever met.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哦，對了。
謝謝你為我承受了這麼多麻煩。你是我見過的最優秀的研究員之一。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Then as promised...
I will give you something from my precious collection! Now, let me see what we have here...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那麼，按照約定...
我會從我的珍藏中拿出一樣東西給你！讓我看看這裡有什麼...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Please...
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
請...
收下這個。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Please accept this as my way of thanking you for assisting in my
research. If the opportunity arises, I would like to ask you for your help once again. Now please, take care.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
請收下這個，以感謝你在我的研究中提供的幫助。如果有機會，我還想再次請求你的幫助。那麼，請保重。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Why are you still here?
I asked you to go find Alfrik.
Ah~ I cannot wait...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
你為什麼還在這裡？
我讓你去找阿爾弗裡克。
啊~我迫不及待了...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I guess it's true that
the four Dwarves have been
awakened. Does this mean that Brisingamen can now be created?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
看來是真的，四位矮人已經甦醒了。這意味著現在可以製作女神項鍊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If such a thing is possible, what do we need in order to create it? Let's review the information you've gathered...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
如果這是可能的，我們需要什麼才能製作它？讓我們回顧一下你收集到的資訊...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
There's Freya's Tear Drop Crystal, Freya's Jewel, the Never-Melting Snow Crystal found where Alfrik
used to stay, the Drifting Air from the path where Dvalin slept. Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
有芙蕾雅的掉落眼淚、芙蕾雅寶石、在阿爾弗裡克曾居住之地找到的雪的結晶，以及德瓦林沉睡之路上的空氣雕像。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Perhaps we could find something from the pond of Freya's Gold Tears where Berling is sleeping,
though I am unsure.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
也許我們可以在貝林沉睡的芙蕾雅金淚之池中找點什麼，雖然我不確定。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I also assume that the splendid Silver Ornament constructed by
Gher is also needed to create Brisingamen.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我也假設，由格雷爾製作的華麗銀飾品也是製作女神項鍊所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So what
do you think?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那麼，你怎麼看？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不確定...

scripts.text: I suppose you're right.
scripts.translation: 我想你說得對

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not sure...
I mean, maybe
Alfrik would
probably know, bu--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不確定...
我是說，也許阿爾弗裡克會知道，但--

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Of course!
That's a great idea! I'll wait here while you go and ask Alfrik. You're my only hope in completing this research!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
當然！
這是個好主意！我會在這裡等你，你去問問阿爾弗裡克。你是我完成這項研究的唯一希望！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I shouldn't have said anything...^000000)

[Enrico Kaili]
Well, what are
waiting for? Please
come back as soon
as possible.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
好了，你還在等什麼？請儘快回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I suppose
you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想你說得對。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Still, who knows what exactly is in the Pond of Freya's Golden Tears.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，誰知道芙蕾雅金淚之池中到底有什麼。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Yes.
Ah! Right.
Hm, perhaps it would be
best to ask Alfrik first?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
是的。
啊！對了。
嗯，也許最好先問問阿爾弗裡克？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hurry and seek him
out! And I thank you
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
快去找到他！
我提前謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I guess he finally sang for you?
By the way, why didn't you speak to Grer the Dwarf? Oh right, the mine is heavily populated with monsters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
看來他終於為你唱了？
順便問一下，你為什麼沒有和矮人格雷爾對話？哦對了，礦洞裡魔物很多。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I know it won't be easy,
but please seek him out
and get more information.
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我知道這不容易，但還是請你去找他，獲取更多資訊。
提前謝謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hm...?
Did you forget the words to the song? Well, I didn't write them down either. Hahahaha! I guess there's only one thing you can do~
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
嗯...？
你忘了那首歌的歌詞嗎？
其實我也沒記下來。哈哈！
看來你只能做一件事了~

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
You've got to go back to Berling and ask him for the lyrics again. Good luck, and don't forget to memorize them this time.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
你得回去找貝林，讓他再告訴你一次歌詞。
祝你好運，這次可別忘了記下來。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It looks like you were able to answer that riddle. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
看來你成功解開了那個謎題。
幹得不錯！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
That strange, unearthly feeling of dampness... Ah, you've brought Freya's Tear Drops! That means Grer must have awakened on his own now.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那種奇怪、非自然的潮溼感...
啊，你帶來了芙蕾雅的掉落眼淚！
這意味著格雷爾應該已經自行甦醒了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I suppose your next course of action should be to enter the mine. I'm sorry for the trouble, but I grow more excited with each new thing we learn.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我想你接下來的行動應該是進入礦洞。
抱歉給你添麻煩了，但隨著我們瞭解到更多新事物，我變得越來越興奮了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It's only with your help that I've been able to make such progress with my research. Anyway, I shall share my conclusions with you later.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
多虧了你的幫助，我的研究才能取得如此進展。
總之，稍後我會把我的結論分享給你。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So are you heading for the mine now? Be careful around those monsters.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那麼你現在要前往礦洞了嗎？
小心那些魔物。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Dvalin's riddle?
He must have been
talking about the
endless war that
Freya had to cause.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
德瓦林的謎題？
他一定是在說芙蕾雅不得不引發的那場無盡的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
There were two kings that
each had twenty knights. The kings and these knights fought and killed each other, and would be brought back to life the next morning by Freya until thousands of Valkyries filled Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
有兩位國王，各自擁有二十名騎士。
國王們和這些騎士互相廝殺，並在第二天清晨被芙蕾雅復活，直到數千名瓦爾基里填滿了瓦爾哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
All forty-two
of them did this...
Everyday. It's an old
story that everyone knows.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
這四十二個人每天都這樣做...
這是一個眾所周知的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
In any case, it's about time that you investigated Berling. There's
a stream that begins northwest of Prontera and passes through a mine in Mount Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
總之，是時候去調查貝林了。
有一條溪流從普隆德拉的西北方發源，流經雷神之錘山的一座礦洞。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
It may be wise to
start your search there and investigate any streams and
puddles that you can find.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
也許從那裡開始搜尋，並調查你能找到的任何溪流和水坑會比較明智。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Are you sure?!
Those items were
intended to create
Freya's necklace,
Brisingamen?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
你確定嗎？！
那些物品是為了製作芙蕾雅的女神項鍊，即女神項鍊？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If the four Dwarves
awaken, Brisingamen may
appear before human eyes?
Fascinating. Just fascinating.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
如果四位矮人甦醒，女神項鍊可能會出現在人類眼前？
太迷人了。
真是迷人極了。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Let's see....
The place where
Dvalin is sleeping?
I assume it may be near
the place where the Monks
train, but I am unsure.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
讓我想想....
德瓦林沉睡的地方？
我假設它可能在武僧訓練的地方附近，但我不確定。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
In any case, it would
to no harm to investigate
any leads yes? The monastery,
I believe, is to the east
of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
總之，調查一下這些線索也無妨，對吧？
修道院，我相信在普隆德拉的東邊。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What...?
You actually
met Alfrik...?
I can't believe
the legendary Alfrick
is still alive...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
什麼...？
你真的見到了阿爾弗裡克...？
我不敢相信傳說中的阿爾弗裡克還活著...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Alfrik is one of the four Dwarves who created Brisingamen, the world's most beautiful necklace, for the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
阿爾弗裡克是四位矮人之一，他們為女神芙蕾雅製作了世界上最美麗的項鍊，女神項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now I realize...
We've been gathering information related to an item containing the power of the gods!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
現在我明白了...
我們一直在收集與一件蘊含神力物品相關的資訊！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Let's see...
There's another Dwarf, Dvalin.
Did Alfrik tell you anything about where Dvalin may be sleeping? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
讓我想想...
還有一位矮人，德瓦林。
阿爾弗裡克有沒有告訴你德瓦林可能在哪兒沉睡？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
For now, I suppose
it would be best to
investigate Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
目前，我覺得最好先去調查一下薑餅城。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Somewhere there, I'm
sure you can find a remaining trace of the goddess Freya. If you were able to meet Valkyrie, I'm sure you'll be able to do this.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
在那裡的某個地方，我相信你一定能找到女神芙蕾雅留下的痕跡。
既然你能見到瓦爾基里，我相信你一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I've been thinking...
About those words
Valkyrie told you
to remember...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我一直在想...
瓦爾基里讓你記住的那些話...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
^4d4dffThe beauty of the stars
Wanes in comparison.
We lost our hearts
To that golden hair
And those dazzling eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
^4d4dff星辰之美
也為之黯然失色。
我們的心
迷失在那金色的秀髮
與那雙耀眼的眼眸裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What could that mean?
I'm beginning to doubt
what I think I know...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那是什麼意思？
我開始懷疑我所知道的一切了...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I can tell you've
gone through a lot...
So what did you hear
from Hermite?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
看得出你經歷了很多...
那麼，你在隱士那裡聽到了什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Enrico Kaili
what you were told by Hermite,
as well as your experiences
with Valkyrie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把隱士告訴你的話，以及你與瓦爾基里相遇的經歷，都告訴了恩里科·凱利。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I can scarcely believe this!
But if what you say is true, it may be possible for humans to possess godly power.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我簡直不敢相信！
但如果你說的是真的，人類或許也能擁有神力。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hm? There's a reaction coming
from this thing that was sent from the royal court. Hm, come closer and take a look.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
嗯？
這個從王宮送來的東西有反應。嗯，靠近點看看。

scripts.text: ^3355FFEnrico opened a locked chest, revealing an incredibly clear, shimmering jewel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科打開了一個上鎖的箱子，裡面有一顆極其清澈、閃閃發光的寶石。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Isn't it amazing?
If what Valkyrie said is true, this jewel must be a crystal from Freya's teardrop.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
是不是很神奇？
如果瓦爾基里說的是真的，這顆寶石一定是芙蕾雅淚滴中的水晶。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I don't understand why all of this is happening so suddenly. For now, I'll have to think about the poem you heard from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我不明白為什麼這一切發生得這麼突然。
目前，我得好好想想你從瓦爾基里那裡聽到的詩篇。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
A cold snowy path on
which the goddess tread.
A blue river the goddess crossed.
A narrow path the goddess passed.
Four Dwarves that the goddess met...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
一條女神踏過的冰冷雪路。
一條女神渡過的藍色河流。
一條女神經過的狹窄小徑。
四位女神遇見的矮人...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I'm sure the four Dwarves are the famous craftsmen I've studied, but I can't determine what the rest of the poem means.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我確信那四位矮人就是我研究過的那些著名工匠，但我無法確定詩篇其餘部分的意思。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now...
I'll need your
help once again!
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
現在...
我又需要你的幫助了！

scripts.text: Wah? It's not over?!
scripts.translation: 哇？還沒結束？！

scripts.text: What is it this time?
scripts.translation: 這次又是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hah...!
Our work has just begun!
Now, head over to Lutie
and find some clues.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哈...！
我們的工作才剛剛開始！
現在，去薑餅城尋找一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
The poem mentions a snowy path, and this jewel was found there, so Lutie is a pretty well educated guess as the location of our next clue.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
詩篇提到了雪路，而這顆寶石就是在那裡找到的，所以薑餅城很可能是我們下一個線索的所在地。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I hope we'll be
able to learn what
the goddess Freya has
left behind in Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
希望我們能弄清楚女神芙蕾雅在米德加爾特留下了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hahahaha...!
I like your attitute!
Once again, Nelliorde has
proven to be an excellent
judge of character.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哈哈哈哈哈...！
我喜歡你的態度！
內利奧德再次證明了他是識人的行家。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
The poem mentions
a snowy path, and this jewel was found in Lutie. So Lutie would be a pretty good place to search for the next clue.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
詩篇提到了雪路，而這顆寶石是在薑餅城找到的。
所以薑餅城很可能是尋找下一個線索的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I hope we'll be
able to learn what
the goddess Freya has
left behind in Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
希望我們能弄清楚女神芙蕾雅在米德加爾特留下了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hmm...?
I see...
I know the work
I'm having you do might
be quite troublesome...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
嗯...？
我明白了...
我知道讓你做的這些工作可能有點麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
But rest assured,
I will reward you
once our work is completed.
Good help such as the kind
you provide is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
但請放心，等我們的工作完成後，我會好好報答你的。
像你這樣的好幫手可是很難找的。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So have you
met Hermite? Hm?
He actually asked
you to do that?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那麼，你見過隱士了嗎？嗯？
他居然讓你去做那個？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
For now, it looks like you might have no alternative. It would probably be wise to do what he wants. Knowing Charles, it's probably won't be too bad.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
目前看來，你似乎別無選擇。最好還是照他說的做吧。以查爾斯的性格，應該不會太糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Hermite...?
Do you need more
information about him?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
隱士...？
你需要更多關於他的資訊嗎？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh, that's right!
He's a registered member of that Monster Research Organization. Why don't you ask the lady over there for more information on him?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哦，對了！
他是那個魔物研究組織的註冊成員。你不妨去問問那邊那位女士，瞭解更多關於他的資訊？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
If she'll let you look at her records, you can probably find out where he lives. Now why don't you talk to that lady towards the left part of this room?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
如果她允許你查閱記錄，你大概能查出他住在哪裡。現在，你不妨去和這個房間左邊的那位女士談談？

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
So, have you
considered my proposal?
Work for me, and I shall
surely repay you.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
那麼，你考慮過我的提議了嗎？
為我工作，我保證會好好報答你的。

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Sure, why not.
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
What...?!
Then why bother
to speak to me?
If you just intend to
bother me, then please
leave right away.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
什...麼？！
那你為什麼還要來和我對話？
如果你只是想打擾我，那就請立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Really?
If you could help me, that would be great! Before we start, would you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
真的嗎？
如果你能幫我，那就太好了！在開始之前，你能看一下這個嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico Kaili showed you a small white crystallization inside a box. It looked very fragile, but emanated an intensely
cold aura.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科·凱利給你看了一個盒子裡的白色小結晶。它看起來非常脆弱，但散發著強烈的寒氣。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I call this the Snow Crystal.
It looks just like a snowflake, doesn't it? Strangely enough,
it's never melted.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我稱它為雪的結晶。
它看起來就像雪花，不是嗎？奇怪的是，它從未融化過。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
A few years ago,
a young adventurer
gave this to me. I need to find this person so that I can find out exactly what this is, as well as where it came from.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
幾年前，一位年輕的冒險者把它給了我。我需要找到這個人，以便弄清楚這到底是什麼，以及它來自哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now, the person
who brought this to
me is, let's see, ah...
Hermite Charles.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
現在，把這件東西帶給我的人，讓我想想，啊...
是隱士 查爾斯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
When you find him,
please give him this letter.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
找到他之後，請把這封信交給他。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico gave you a small
letter addressed to Hermite
Charles that is sealed with
red wax.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科給你了一封寫給隱士 查爾斯的小信，上面封著紅色的蠟封。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Ah, you've arrived!
{0}, right?
Yes, I was told by Nelliorde that you'd come. He always manages
to find me good, reliable help.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
啊，你來了！
{0}，對吧？
內利奧德告訴我你會來。他總是能幫我找到可靠的好幫手。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
As Nelliorde probably mentioned,
I need some help in completing my research. Since you adventurers are always traveling, I was hoping you'd help me find someone.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
內利奧德可能已經提過了，我需要一些幫助來完成我的研究。既然你們冒險者總是四處旅行，我希望你能幫我找一個人。

scripts.text: I'm no good at finding people.
scripts.translation: 我不擅長找人

scripts.text: I can do that!
scripts.translation: 我可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Oh... Really?
I was really hoping that you'd be able to help me. But I understand if it's not within your capacity.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
哦...是嗎？
我真的很希望你能幫幫我。不過，如果這超出了你的能力範圍，我也能理解。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I suppose I can try to find another adventurer to help me. But if you change your mind later, please do not hesitate to lend me your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我想我可以試著找另一位冒險者來幫忙。但如果你之後改變主意了，請隨時伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Really?
If you could help me, that would be great! Before we start, would you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
真的嗎？
如果你能幫我，那就太好了！在開始之前，你能看一下這個嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico Kaili showed you a small white crystallization inside a box. It looked very fragile, but emanated an intensely
cold aura.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科·凱利給你看了一個盒子裡的白色小結晶。它看起來非常脆弱，但散發著強烈的寒氣。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I call this the Snow Crystal.
It looks just like a snowflake, doesn't it? Strangely enough,
it's never melted.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我稱它為雪的結晶。
它看起來就像雪花，不是嗎？奇怪的是，它從未融化過。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
A few years ago,
a young adventurer
gave this to me. I need to find this person so that I can find out exactly what this is, as well as where it came from.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
幾年前，一位年輕的冒險者把它給了我。我需要找到這個人，以便弄清楚這到底是什麼，以及它來自哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Now, the person
who brought this to
me is, let's see, ah...
Hermite Charles.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
現在，把這件東西帶給我的人，讓我想想，啊...
是隱士 查爾斯。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
When you find him,
please give him this letter.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
找到他之後，請把這封信交給他。

scripts.text:
^3355FFEnrico gave you a small
letter addressed to Hermite
Charles that is sealed with
red wax.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF恩里科給你了一封寫給隱士 查爾斯的小信，上面封著紅色的蠟封。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
I'm not exactly sure why you've come to me, but I apologize for the fact that I'm unable to help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
我不太確定你為什麼來找我，但很抱歉，我目前無法幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Enrico Kaili]
Right now, I'm far
too busy trying to
complete my research.
Please leave me alone
to do my work.
scripts.translation:
[恩里科·凱利]
現在，我正忙著完成我的研究。
請讓我一個人專心工作。

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
Do you know how
to make Red Potions?
You grind a lot of Red Herbs and carefully shake the liquid until you achieve the desire consistency.
scripts.translation:
[研讀中的學者]
你知道怎麼做紅色藥水嗎？
你需要研磨大量的紅色藥草，然後小心地搖晃液體，直到達到理想的濃度。

scripts.text:
[Studying Scholar]
If I could find a way
to produce them much faster,
I'd become rich in no time...
scripts.translation:
[研讀中的學者]
如果我能找到一種更快的生產方法，我很快就會變得富有...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
Let everyone live a life
of happiness. Let there be
peace in the world...
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的男子]
願眾生幸福。
願世界和平...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
May I hit it rich with this
Old Blue Box that I spend this
month's paycheck on...
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的男子]
願我用這個月工資買的神秘箱子能讓我發大財...

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
Now is the time to reflect upon the past to prepare for the future.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的男子]
現在是反思過去，為未來做準備的時候了。

scripts.text:
[Praying Man]
It is in stillness that we find the wisdom to know which steps we must take to move forward. Let's pray.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的男子]
在寧靜中，我們才能找到智慧，知道該邁出哪一步才能前進。讓我們祈禱吧。

scripts.text: ^3355FFHermite Charles continues to fervently pray. His eyes are closed and his hands are clasped to his chest. There seems to be an air of faint sadness about him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隱士 查爾斯仍在虔誠地祈禱。他閉著眼睛，雙手合十放在胸前。他身上似乎籠罩著一層淡淡的悲傷。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
What did you just say?
Did she really become an
Einherjar? That's the greatest honor for any warrior...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你剛才說什麼？
她真的成為了英靈戰士？那是任何戰士至高無上的榮耀...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She must
be so happy.
I guess in the end,
I never really had
any place in her heart.
Lowen...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
她一定很幸福吧。
我想，到頭來，我在她心中並沒有真正的位置。
洛溫...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But I know one thing
for sure. She should have blamed me for what happened. Why did she take everything upon herself?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
但有一件事我很確定。她本該責怪我的。為什麼她要獨自承擔一切？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I guess she just saw me as a little brother. She obviously didn't take me very seriously.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我想她只是把我當作弟弟。她顯然沒有很認真地對待我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Haha... Hahaha...
Now I feel better!
So, what did you say?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
哈哈...哈哈哈...
現在我感覺好多了！
那麼，你剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Yes, right.
Please tell Enrico this.
The object he's interested in was given by His Majesty to a guild that possessed a castle.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
是的，沒錯。
請告訴恩里科這件事。
他感興趣的那個物品，是陛下賜予擁有城堡的公會的。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
It can never be made through just human technology. But I guess that His Majesty will let scholars study it and let men possess it if they prove capable.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
它絕非僅憑人類科技所能製造。不過我想，陛下會讓學者們研究它，並允許證明自己有資格的人擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I wasn't powerful enough to
earn it. Frankly, I stole it. But soon I began to fear its presense and my heart would pound with trepidation when I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我當時實力不夠，無法獲得它。說實話，我是偷來的。但很快我就開始害怕它的存在，每次看到它，我的心都會因恐懼而劇烈跳動。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
One day, I think it actually possessed me and I ended up
going on a journey. I'm not really sure exactly where though...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
有一天，我覺得它似乎附身了我，我竟然開始了一段旅程。我也不太確定具體去了哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
All I remember was that I was in Lutie, the town of snow. I went over a bridge to a hill to the West...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我只記得我身處薑餅城，那座雪之鎮。我走過一座橋，來到了西邊的山丘...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But once I arrived there, I was seized with this feeling of terror I can't explain.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
但當我到達那裡時，一種無法形容的恐懼感攫住了我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I ended up running away.
That's why I gave it to Mr. Enrico. You can laugh at me for being a coward if you want.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
最後我逃跑了。
所以我把它交給了恩里科先生。如果你想嘲笑我是個膽小鬼，那就笑吧。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You know everything now.
Please leave me alone.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
現在你什麼都知道了。
請讓我一個人待著。
^333333*嘆息...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'll be waiting.
For some reason, I believe you'll be able to find some sort of clue about what happened these past
two years one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我會等著的。
不知為何，我相信總有一天你能找到關於過去兩年發生之事的線索。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lohen Phelicia?
The person I asked you to find is Lowen, not Lohen. Lowen Ellenen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
洛恩·菲麗西亞？
我讓你找的人是洛溫，不是洛恩。是洛溫·艾萊南。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm sorry
for the trouble,
but I think you
better try again.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
抱歉給你添麻煩了，但我覺得你最好再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Yes...
Lowen is no
longer with us.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
是的...
洛溫已經不在了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I've heard different rumors, but she definitely passed away. I was even at her funeral.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我聽過各種傳聞，但她確實已經去世了。我還參加了她的葬禮。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
The last time I saw her alive
was in Geffen. Two years after that, I saw her buried in her grave. Didn't I tell you this?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我最後一次見到她活著是在吉芬。兩年後，我看到她被安葬在墓中。我沒告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I wanted you to find out what happened in those two years before she died. I wanted to know what led to her death.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我想讓你查清她死前那兩年發生了什麼。我想知道是什麼導致了她的死亡。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
What the hell
killed her?!
Don't you understand
the way I feel?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
到底是什麼殺死了她？！
你難道不明白我現在的感受嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lowen was a Crusader, a knight in the service of holiness preparing for the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
洛溫是一名十字軍，一位侍奉神聖、為聖戰做準備的騎士。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I always expected her to
become a Knight in the Prontera Chivalry, but suddenly she changed her mind and became a Crusader.
I saw her for the last time in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我一直期待她成為普隆德拉騎士團的一員，但她突然改變了主意，成為了十字軍。
我最後一次見到她是在吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I beg you...
Please learn
anything you can
about what happened
to Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我懇求你...
請儘可能多地瞭解洛溫身上發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You're still here.
Does that mean you
want to hear my
story after all?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你還在這裡。
難道這意味著你還是想聽我的故事嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I would like to.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想聽

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Thank you...
Perhaps you're doing this
merely out of consideration,
but I still appreciate your kindness. The story I will
tell you is very old.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
謝謝你...
也許你只是出於禮貌，但我依然感激你的善意。
我要告訴你的故事，已經非常久遠了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, there was a little boy who never knew his parents. Just
to survive, he became a Thief and eventually joined the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
很久以前，有一個從未見過父母的小男孩。
為了生存，他成為了盜賊，最終加入了流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Without any goals or dreams, his life was pretty aimless. He pretty much only lived so that he could see tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
沒有目標，也沒有夢想，他的生活相當迷茫。
他活著，只是為了能看到明天。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
However, the little boy met someone who was full of hope and kindess. He admired her and she became his reason for living.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
然而，這個小男孩遇到了一個充滿希望且善良的人。
他仰慕著她，她成為了他活下去的理由。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She will never know that the little boy loved her more than anything else. Unlike the boy, her dream was devote her life to God.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
她永遠不會知道，這個小男孩愛她勝過一切。
與男孩不同，她的夢想是將生命奉獻給神。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although he never understood that, he knew that he would be happy to just be near her, watching from a distance.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
雖然他從未真正理解這一點，但他知道，只要能在她身邊，遠遠地看著她，他就會感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But one day, because of one fatal mistake, he lost her and she never came back.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
但有一天，因為一個致命的錯誤，他失去了她，她再也沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Ever since, that boy has been coming to the Sanctuary everyday
to pray for her safety, even into adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
從那以後，那個男孩每天都來到光耀之堂，為她祈禱平安，直到成年。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sob*^000000
Please find
her for me.
Find Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
...
^333333*啜泣*^000000
請幫我找到她。
找到洛溫。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I know that Enrico has sent you. I'm guessing he needs something from me. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我知道是恩里科派你來的。
我猜他需要我幫個忙。
我猜得沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'll do whatever you want if you do what I want you to do. It's simple: find out anything you can about Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
如果你答應我的請求，我就答應你的請求。
很簡單：
儘可能多地瞭解洛溫的情況。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
It's doesn't matter how insignificant the clues may be, anything will do. I want to know everything related to her!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
無論線索多麼微不足道，什麼都行。
我想知道與她有關的一切！

scripts.text: Uhhhhh...
Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行

scripts.text: When was the last time you saw her?
scripts.translation: 你最後一次見到她是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please consider my
proposal. If you can
find Lowen for me, I'll
give you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
請考慮一下我的提議。
如果你能幫我找到洛溫，我會給你你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please, I beg you.
You are a strong and well-experienced adventurer. Isn't this a simple thing for you to do?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
拜託了，我懇求你。
你是一位強大且經驗豐富的冒險者。
對你來說，這應該是一件簡單的事吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
If you've ever dearly loved someone, then you'd know how desperate I am. Please find Lowen for me. Please...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
如果你曾經深愛過某人，你就會明白我有多絕望。
請幫我找到洛溫。
拜託了...

scripts.text: ...Alright.
scripts.translation: ...好吧

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I don't think I can do it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我想我做不到

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
I'll try my best to find her. Would you tell me more about Lowen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
我會盡力找到她的。
能告訴我更多關於洛溫的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She is a Crusader.
The last time I saw her was
deep inside Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
她是一名十字軍。
我最後一次見到她，是在吉芬地下城深處。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, some Crusaders entered the Geffen Dungeon on a monster subjugation expedition.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
很久以前，一些十字軍為了平定魔物，進入了吉芬地下城。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please find
anything that
you can. I beg
of you...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
請找到任何你能找到的線索。
拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I understand.
But if you don't help me, then Kaili won't get the help he needs...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
^333333*嘆息*^000000
我理解。
但如果你不幫我，凱利就無法得到他需要的幫助了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You don't understand!
If I weren't this much of a coward, I would already have gone out to find out what I could for myself.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你不懂！
如果我沒有這麼懦弱，我早就自己去查明真相了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm not afraid of monsters or dying. It's the fact that she might hate me now. That's what I fear: Lowen's reproach.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我不怕魔物，也不怕死。
我怕的是她現在可能恨我。
這才是我恐懼的：洛溫的責備。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
All I can do for her is just earnestly pray. I had no idea it'd be so horrible not to be able to see her anymore...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我能為她做的，只有虔誠地祈禱。
我沒想到再也見不到她會這麼痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
The last time
I saw her was deep
inside the Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我最後一次見到她，是在吉芬地下城深處。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although it was created by humans, that dungeon is now cursed and inhabited with horrific monsters.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
雖然那座地下城是人類建造的，但現在它已被詛咒，棲息著可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm guessing the Crusaders saw that it was necessary to exterminate the monsters there to keep it from getting even worse.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我猜那些十字軍認為，必須消滅那裡的魔物，以免情況變得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lowen accompanied
a group of other Crusaders
for the good of the people,
but I haven't heard anything
about her since...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
洛溫為了眾人的利益，跟隨一群十字軍去了那裡，但自那以後，我就再也沒聽到過她的訊息...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
That was the last time...
Please find out anything
you can. I beg you...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
那是最後一次...
請查明任何你能查到的事。
拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I misunderstood you.
I should have realized that people never really listen unless it's of some benefit to them.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我誤會你了。
我本該明白，除非對人們有利，否則他們根本不會聽。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I won't waste any more of
your time. I'll accept Kaili's letter and wait until I find someone who'll listen to
my story and help me.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我不再浪費你的時間了。
我會收下凱利的信，等待有人願意聽我的故事並幫助我。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sob...*^000000
I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry, Lowen.
It was all my fault...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
...
^333333*啜泣...*^000000
對不起。
對不起，洛溫。
都是我的錯...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
What do you
want from me?
Were you sent by
the Rogue Guild?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你想要什麼？
你是流氓公會派來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Tell them
I quit already.
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
告訴他們，我已經退會了。
別煩我！

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 別管他

scripts.text: Give him Kaili's Letter.
scripts.translation: 給他凱利的信

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou're not sure why he's so upset, but it doesn't seem to be the best time to try to speak with him. Perhaps later would be better...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你不確定他為什麼這麼激動，但現在似乎不是和他對話的好時機。也許稍後再試會更好...^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Huh...
Enrico Kaili.
Yeah, I remember
him. So what..?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
嗯...
恩里科·凱利。
啊，我記得他。
那又怎樣？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHermite nonchalantly
tosses the letter back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隱士漫不經心地把信扔回給你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Hermite Charles]
You...
Would you like to
listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你...
想聽聽我的故事嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: I'm busy, actually.
scripts.translation: 我其實很忙

如果你曾經深愛過某人，你就會明白我有多絕望。
請幫我找到洛溫。
拜託了...

scripts.text: ...Alright.
scripts.translation: ...好吧

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I don't think I can do it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我想我做不到

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
I'll try my best to find her. Would you tell me more about Lowen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
我會盡力找到她的。
能告訴我更多關於洛溫的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She is a Crusader.
The last time I saw her was
deep inside Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
她是一名十字軍。
我最後一次見到她，是在吉芬地下城深處。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, some Crusaders entered the Geffen Dungeon on a monster subjugation expedition.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
很久以前，一些十字軍為了平定魔物，進入了吉芬地下城。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please find
anything that
you can. I beg
of you...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
請找到任何你能找到的線索。
拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I understand.
But if you don't help me, then Kaili won't get the help he needs...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
^333333*嘆息*^000000
我理解。
但如果你不幫我，凱利就無法得到他需要的幫助了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
You don't understand!
If I weren't this much of a coward, I would already have gone out to find out what I could for myself.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你不懂！
如果我沒有這麼懦弱，我早就自己去查明真相了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm not afraid of monsters or dying. It's the fact that she might hate me now. That's what I fear: Lowen's reproach.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我不怕魔物，也不怕死。
我怕的是她現在可能恨我。
這才是我恐懼的：洛溫的責備。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
All I can do for her is just earnestly pray. I had no idea it'd be so horrible not to be able to see her anymore...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我能為她做的，只有虔誠地祈禱。
我沒想到再也見不到她會這麼痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
The last time
I saw her was deep
inside the Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我最後一次見到她，是在吉芬地下城深處。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although it was created by humans, that dungeon is now cursed and inhabited with horrific monsters.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
雖然那座地下城是人類建造的，但現在它已被詛咒，棲息著可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'm guessing the Crusaders saw that it was necessary to exterminate the monsters there to keep it from getting even worse.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我猜那些十字軍認為，必須消滅那裡的魔物，以免情況變得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lowen accompanied
a group of other Crusaders
for the good of the people,
but I haven't heard anything
about her since...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
洛溫為了眾人的利益，跟隨一群十字軍去了那裡，但自那以後，我就再也沒聽到過她的訊息...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
That was the last time...
Please find out anything
you can. I beg you...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
那是最後一次...
請查明任何你能查到的事。
拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I misunderstood you.
I should have realized that people never really listen unless it's of some benefit to them.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我誤會你了。
我本該明白，除非對人們有利，否則他們根本不會聽。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I won't waste any more of
your time. I'll accept Kaili's letter and wait until I find someone who'll listen to
my story and help me.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我不再浪費你的時間了。
我會收下凱利的信，等待有人願意聽我的故事並幫助我。

scripts.text:
[Sad-looking Man]
...
^333333*Sob...*^000000
I am so
sorry, Lowen.
It's all fault...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
I am looking
for someone named...
Hermite?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。
我在找一個人...
隱士？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Hm...?
Hermite? That's me.
But if you don't mind,
I want to be alone...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
嗯？
隱士？那就是我。
但是如果不介意的話，我想一個人待著...

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 別管他

scripts.text: Give him Kaili's Letter.
scripts.translation: 給他凱利的信

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou're not sure why he's so upset, but it doesn't seem to be the best time to try to speak with him. Perhaps later would be better...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你不確定他為什麼這麼激動，但現在似乎不是和他對話的好時機。也許稍後再試會更好...^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Huh...
Enrico Kaili.
Yeah, I remember
him. So what..?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
嗯...
恩里科·凱利。
啊，我記得他。
那又怎樣？

scripts.text:
^3355FFHermite nonchalantly
tosses the letter back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隱士漫不經心地把信扔回給你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Hermite Charles]
You...
Would you like to
listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
你...
想聽聽我的故事嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: I'm busy, actually.
scripts.translation: 我其實很忙

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Thank you...
Perhaps you're doing this
merely out of consideration,
but I still appreciate your kindness. The story I will
tell you is very old.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
謝謝你...
也許你只是出於禮貌，但我依然感激你的善意。
我要告訴你的故事，已經非常久遠了。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Long ago, there was a little boy who never knew his parents. Just
to survive, he became a Thief and eventually joined the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
很久以前，有一個從未見過父母的小男孩。
為了生存，他成為了盜賊，最終加入了流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Without any goals or dreams, his life was pretty aimless. He pretty much only lived so that he could see tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
沒有目標，也沒有夢想，他的生活相當迷茫。
他活著，只是為了能看到明天。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
However, the little boy met someone who was full of hope and kindess. He admired her and she became his reason for living.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
然而，這個小男孩遇到了一個充滿希望且善良的人。
他仰慕著她，她成為了他活下去的理由。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
She will never know that the little boy loved her more than anything else. Unlike the boy, her dream was devote her life to God.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
她永遠不會知道，這個小男孩愛她勝過一切。
與男孩不同，她的夢想是將生命奉獻給神。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Although he never understood that, he knew that he would be happy to just be near her, watching from a distance.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
雖然他從未真正理解這一點，但他知道，只要能在她身邊，遠遠地看著她，他就會感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
But one day, because of one fatal mistake, he lost her and she never came back.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
但有一天，因為一個致命的錯誤，他失去了她，她再也沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Ever since, that boy has been coming to the Sanctuary everyday
to pray for her safety, even into adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
從那以後，那個男孩每天都來到光耀之堂，為她祈禱平安，直到成年。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
...
^333333*Sob*^000000
Please find
her for me.
Find Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
...
^333333*啜泣*^000000
請幫我找到她。
找到洛溫。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I know that Enrico has sent you. I'm guessing he needs something from me. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
我知道是恩里科派你來的。
我猜他需要我幫個忙。
我猜得沒錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
I'll do whatever you want if you do what I want you to do. It's simple: find out anything you can about Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
如果你答應我的請求，我就答應你的請求。
很簡單：
儘可能多地瞭解洛溫的情況。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
It's doesn't matter how insignificant the clues may be, anything will do. I want to know everything related to her!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
無論線索多麼微不足道，什麼都行。
我想知道與她有關的一切！

scripts.text: Uhhhhh...
Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行

scripts.text: When was the last time you saw her?
scripts.translation: 你最後一次見到她是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please consider my
proposal. If you can
find Lowen for me, I'll
give you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
請考慮一下我的提議。
如果你能幫我找到洛溫，我會給你你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Please, I beg you.
You are a strong and well-experienced adventurer. Isn't this a simple thing for you to do?
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
拜託了，我懇求你。
你是一位強大且經驗豐富的冒險者。
對你來說，這應該是一件簡單的事吧？

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
If you've ever dearly loved someone, then you'd know how desperate I am. Please find Lowen for me. Please...
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
如果你曾經深愛過某人，你就會明白我有多絕望。
