[Sad-looking Man]
...
^333333*Sob...*
Lowen...
I'm so sorry.
It's all my fault.
Please be okay...
scripts.translation:
[神情悲傷的男子]
...
^333333*啜泣...*
洛溫...
對不起。
都是我的錯。
請一定要沒事...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing here?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你在這裡做什麼？
別亂碰東西！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing here?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你在這裡做什麼？
別亂碰東西！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Zzzzz...
...Zzzzz...
......Zzzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
呼嚕嚕...
...呼嚕嚕...
......呼嚕嚕嚕...

scripts.text: ^3355FFThis librarian seems to be deeply asleep. It'd be smarter not to wake him if you want to check the Crusader Personnel Records.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這點陣圖書管理員似乎睡得很沉。如果你想查閱十字軍人事檔案，最好別叫醒他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
All confidential personnel records are kept here in the royal library. However, you need authorization
for full access.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
所有機密人事檔案都儲存在皇家圖書館。不過，你需要獲得授權才能完全訪問。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Did you say that you
need to find a person?
Please give me that
person's name, as well
as your relationship.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你說你需要找一個人？
請告訴我那個人的名字，以及你們的關係。

scripts.text: Lowen, Sibling
scripts.translation: 洛溫，兄弟姐妹

scripts.text: Lowen, Spouse
scripts.translation: 洛溫，配偶

scripts.text: Lowen, Enemy
scripts.translation: 洛溫，敵人

scripts.text: Lowen, a Friend
scripts.translation: 洛溫，朋友

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
How dare you
lie to the royal
librarian!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你竟敢對皇家圖書管理員撒謊！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
It says here
in the records
that Lowen did not
have any male siblings!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
檔案上寫著，洛溫沒有任何男性兄弟姐妹！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^333333(Crap...!
I just disclosed
^666666classified^000000 ^333333info!)^000000

[Librarian]
The Royal Library won't
tolerate identity fraud!
Please leave!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
皇家圖書館絕不容忍身份造假！
請離開！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
You're related to Miss Lowen? How have you not received any news about her before?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你是洛溫小姐的親屬？
之前怎麼沒收到過關於她的訊息？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I see...
Separated at birth,
that's truly tragic.
Okay, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
原來如此...
出生時分離，真是令人難過。
好的，讓我查一下。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I feel terrible telling you this, but it's too late to find Lowen Ellenen, according to the records.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
很抱歉要告訴你這個，但根據檔案記錄，洛溫·艾萊南已經找不到了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
During the monster subjugation mission in Geffen dungeon she reportedly disappeared and... was later pronounced dead.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
據記載，她在吉芬地下城的魔物討伐任務中失蹤，後來被宣告死亡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
I'm sorry, but
that's all I know.
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
很抱歉，我只知道這些。
謝謝...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Spouse...?
Well, I guess you look like a husband. Heh, I've got a girlfriend myself. Well, at least I think so. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
配偶...？
嗯，我看你倒像是個丈夫。
嘿嘿，我自己也有女朋友。
至少我是這麼認為的。總之...

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Lowen Ellenen
the Crusader, right?
I'm so... sorry.
You might want
to have a seat.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
洛溫·艾萊南，那位十字軍，對吧？
我...很抱歉。
您可能想坐一下。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
During the monster
subjugation in Geffen
Dungeon, she reportedly
disappeared. And later,
she was pronounced dead.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
在吉芬地下城的魔物討伐任務中，她據記載失蹤了。
後來，她被宣告死亡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
That's all the
information I have,
sir. I'm truly sorry
for your loss.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
先生，這就是我所掌握的全部資訊。
對於您的損失，我深表哀悼。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Hmmm...?
Spouse?
Or ^333333*Ahem*^000000
cohabitational partners?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
嗯...？
配偶？
還是^333333*咳咳*^000000
同居伴侶？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe librarian
now seems awfully
distracted, as if
he were lost in
vivid daydream...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF圖書管理員現在看起來非常心不在焉，彷彿陷入了生動的白日夢中...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]

for Ellenen.
Lowen Ellenen.
My sworn arch-enemy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在找艾萊南。
洛溫·艾萊南。
我的死對頭。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
很抱歉，我無法透露更多的資訊。

record of someone

scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
朋友...？
嗯，我們有一個名叫洛溫·菲莉卡的記錄。

[Librarian]
He retired from the service a few years ago. I'd like to give you his address, but we don't have any of that information.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
他幾年前退役了。
我想給你他的地址，但我們沒有這方面的資訊。

[Librarian]
Now, may
I excuse myself?
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
那麼，我可以告辭了嗎？
謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
All confidential personnel records are kept here in the royal library. However, you need authorization
for full access.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
所有機密人事檔案都儲存在皇家圖書館。不過，你需要獲得授權才能完全訪問。

take a walk.
scripts.translation:

嗯？

scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
你是之前來過這裡的人嗎？

[Rosa Ellenen]

to tell you this, but...
This is Lowen's grave.
And thank you.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
我不知道該怎麼開口，但是...
這裡是洛溫的墓。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
What are you
talking about?
A message from Lowen?
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
你在說什麼？
洛溫的留言？

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
What?!
Why hasn't she
gone to heaven yet?
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
什麼？！
為什麼她還沒有去往天堂？

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
I hope you remember
everything I'm going
to tell you. She should
go to heaven right now!
I still don't understand...
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
我希望你能記住我接下來要告訴你的話。她應該立刻去往天堂！
我到現在還是不明白...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
And please tell that praying fool that he shouldn't waste his time blaming himself. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 I still don't know why she chose to
speak to you.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
還有，請告訴那個只會祈禱的傻瓜，不要浪費時間自責了。^333333*嘆息*^000000 我依然不知道她為什麼選擇與你對話。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Let me tell you something. Lowen was a fencing prodigy. However, she always had trouble enduring the rigorous training and bearing the weight of the armor...
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
讓我告訴你一些事情。洛溫是個擊劍天才。然而，她總是難以忍受嚴苛的訓練，也承受不了盔甲的重量...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
But she loved fencing and always tried twice as hard to develop her physical strength so that she could serve God in battle.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
但她熱愛擊劍，總是加倍努力鍛鍊體能，以便能在戰鬥中侍奉神。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Finally, she became a Crusader.
For a while things were great, but then she suddenly disappeared while on a mission to Geffen Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
最終，她成為了一名十字軍。
有一段時間一切都很順利，但後來她在執行前往吉芬地下城的任務時突然失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Two years later, she was buried in this grave after her body was found by some adventurers. I was given the broken shards of armor and a blood stained ribbon she left behind.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
兩年後，她的遺體被一些冒險者發現，並安葬在這座墓中。我收到了她留下的破碎盔甲碎片和一條染血的絲帶。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
I never really learned what exactly happened. And Hermite was always following her like she was his real sister. Ever since she died, he's changed. I hope he doesn't hurt himself...
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
我始終沒能弄清到底發生了什麼。隱士一直像對待親姐姐一樣跟著她。自從她死後，他就變了。我希望他不會傷害自己...

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
Something suspicious seems to have happened in the military, but they won't even talk to me about it. What could have happened?!
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
軍隊裡似乎發生了一些可疑的事情，但他們甚至不肯跟我談。到底發生了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]
In the end, I gave up trying to find the truth. After all, nothing can bring her back...
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
最後，我放棄了尋找真相。畢竟，沒有什麼能讓她復活...

scripts.text:

heaven! Maybe...
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
請告訴她我很好，但我想知道為什麼她的靈魂還沒有去往天堂！也許...

Records that might

也許十字軍的人事檔案裡有什麼能解釋這一切？

scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
這是我妹妹的墓...
她的名字叫洛溫。

scripts.translation:

[Rosa Ellenen]
He was shocked when Lowen

scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
洛溫去世時他受到了很大的打擊，但他不必為她的死自責。我不希望他被愧疚折磨。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Ellenen]

my little sister. It's good to know she has friends, even after she's passed on.
scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]

scripts.translation:
[蘿絲·艾萊南]
哦，你好...
你是來向這裡的某人致敬的嗎？

你現在能看見我了嗎？
你一定很驚訝。
這就是我要與你分享的故事。

scripts.translation:

看看四周。
認出來了嗎？
我們還在同一個地方，只是現在回到了我的過去。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
All of us came here to Geffen to cleanse this area of evil spirits. You asked for the reason I remained in this awful place?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我們所有人都來到吉芬，為了淨化這片區域的邪惡靈魂。你想知道我為什麼留在這個可怕的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I couldn't forgive myself for what I've done to my comrades. They
were killed because of me.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我無法原諒自己對同志們所做的一切。他們是因為我才死的。

scripts.text: You were cursed...?
scripts.translation: 你被詛咒了...？

scripts.text: You still have something to do.
scripts.translation: 你還有事要做

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
被犧牲的同志們詛咒...起初我是這麼想的。所以我試圖贖罪，併為他們的死復仇。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I have been trying my best to comfort their spirits for 2 years.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
自從你們任務失敗後，你就在這裡殺了兩年魔物？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Yes, that's right.
I thought it would bring comfort to the spirits of my comrades.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
是的，沒錯。
我以為這樣能安撫同志們靈魂的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But once I died, I met all of my old friends in Niflheim, the town of the dead. You've heard of it, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
但當我死後，我在尼芙菲姆——亡者之鎮，見到了我所有的老朋友。你聽說過那裡，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
No one seemed to
blame me for what
had happened. In fact, they all seemed worried about me.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
沒有人責怪我發生了什麼事。事實上，他們似乎都在擔心我。

scripts.text: Then why?
scripts.translation: 那是為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
They waited for me in Niflheim for two years, since they didn't want me to misunderstand them. They never blamed me for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
他們在尼芙菲姆等了我兩年，因為他們不想讓我誤解他們。他們從未責怪我發生了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But I still feel like something is wrong. Out of all of us, I'm the only one unable to rest in peace. Everyone else was selected to go to Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
但我總覺得有什麼不對勁。在我們所有人中，只有我一個人無法安息。其他人都被選中前往瓦爾哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
But Valhalla is where all honorable Crusaders are supposed to go. What have I done wrong?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
但瓦爾哈拉是所有光榮的十字軍應該去的地方。我做錯了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I don't think I have any unfinished business. But who knows, maybe there is something I have to do.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我不認為我有什麼未了的心願。但誰知道呢，也許有什麼事是我必須做的。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
All of my late comrades that I met in Niflheim were selected by Valkyrie and sent to Valhalla. That's how honorable Crusaders spend the afterlife. But it looks like I don't deserve it...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我在尼芙菲姆遇到的所有已故同志，都被瓦爾基里選中送往瓦爾哈拉。這就是光榮的十字軍度過來世的方式。但看起來我不配得到它...

scripts.text: I can help you!
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你！

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
You can
help me?
How...?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
你...能幫我？
怎麼...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said this is the place where the subjugation mission happened, right? I'll fight with you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說這裡是鎮壓任務發生的地方，對吧？我會和你一起戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now come on, you don't deserve to feel guilty like this. Let's think about how we're gonna fight these monsters!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，你不應該像這樣感到內疚。讓我們想想怎麼對付這些魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
...
Thank you.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
...
謝謝你。
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now,
shall we go in?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，我們要進去了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Walk down the stairs
ahead. From this point
I can only travel with
you in your mind...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
沿著前面的樓梯走下去。從這裡開始，我只能在你腦海中與你同行...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
How come...
You're here?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
怎麼會...
你在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Have you volunteered for monster subjugation? Would you like to start the mission now?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你報名參加魔物鎮壓任務了嗎？你想現在開始任務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We're you're ready,
come and stand in
front of me.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果你準備好了，請站到我面前。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
No problem, just come back when your preparations are completed.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
沒問題，等你準備完畢後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please back away.
You are not permitted
to enter!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
請退後。
你無權進入！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please back away.
You are not permitted
to enter!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
請退後。
你無權進入！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please back away.
You are not permitted
to enter!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
請退後。
你無權進入！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
Isn't this...?!

[{0}]
Ah, I see.
This must be the place where everything happened two years ago. Good, good...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，我明白了。
這裡一定是兩年前發生一切的地方。很好，很好...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Shshh...
This is just a reflection of the past. Here, you'll see what happened at the time for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
噓...
這只是過去的倒影。在這裡，你會親眼看到當時發生的一切。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
It wasn't any trouble
getting down here. But...
We've got problems now.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
來到這裡並沒有遇到什麼麻煩。但是...
我們現在遇到了問題。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Doppelganger?!

[{0}]
What's going on?
Did you really fight with that creature? H-hey! Answer me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？
你真的和那個生物戰鬥過嗎？喂！回答我！

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Yes, this was the place...
The commander gave orders
and then... What happened?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
是的，這裡就是那個地方...
指揮官下達了命令，然後...發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
^4E2F2F[Crusader Commander]
Everyone, get into your positions! Front line, block its movement! Rear line, support the defense!^000000
scripts.translation:
^4E2F2F[十字軍指揮官]
所有人，進入戰鬥位置！前排，阻擋它的行動！後排，支援防禦！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
N-no!
I'm not running away!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
不...不！
我沒有逃跑！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou're filled with a great anxiety, and you experience for yourself the fear and pressure Lowen felt during those very moments.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你心中充滿了巨大的焦慮，親身感受到了洛溫在那一刻所經歷的恐懼與壓力。^000000

scripts.text:
^4E2F2F[Crusader Commander]
Go, Lowen!
Cast Grand Cross, now!^000000
scripts.translation:
^4E2F2F[十字軍指揮官]
快，洛溫！
現在施放聖十字審判！^000000

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Lowen!
Noooooooooo!!!
scripts.translation:
[男性的聲音]
洛溫！
不——————！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
Isn't that...
What's Hermite
doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡？
那不是...
隱士查爾斯為什麼會在這裡？！

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
No, no, no!
Lowen don't...!
He's gonna kill you!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
不，不，不！
洛溫，不要...！
他會殺了你的！

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Grand Cross?!
Using that's
committing suicide!
Lowen, don't do it!
Don't do that, Lowen!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
聖十字審判？！
使用那個技能等於自殺！
洛溫，不要這樣做！
別那樣做，洛溫！

scripts.text:
[Hermite Charles]
Lowen!
Noooooooooo!!!
scripts.translation:
[隱士 查爾斯]
洛溫！
不——————！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did he go?
Was... Was that
from his mind?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他去哪了？
那...那是來自他腦海中的記憶嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
...
I see now.
I know...
What happened...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
...
我明白了。
我知道了...
當時發生了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I was a fool.
Now I remember Hermite. He must have been the one who rescued me. But when I came to my senses, no one was there.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我真傻。
現在我想起來了，是隱士救了我。但當我恢復意識時，那裡已經沒有人了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I blamed myself for surviving alone. I should have died there with my friends. I felt so useless.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我責怪自己獨自活了下來。我應該和朋友們一起死在那裡。我覺得自己毫無用處。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Now I realize that there were many people who loved me. But at the time, I felt only guilt.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
現在我意識到，有很多人是愛我的。但當時，我只感受到了愧疚。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I returned 3 days later to my commander. It was stupid, but at the moment I couldn't think of anything else.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
三天後，我回到了指揮官面前。
雖然很愚蠢，但當時我實在想不出別的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
The higher ups and the politicians were looking for a scapegoat for the failure of the mission.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
高層和政客們正在為這次任務的失敗尋找替罪羔羊。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
So I was the one who was blamed. Then, they took away everything I had. My status, the holy power granted to me...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
於是，所有的罪責都落在了我身上。
隨後，他們奪走了我擁有的一切。我的地位，賜予我的神聖力量...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I thought I deserved that punishment. After all, why should
I have survived when all my comrades died?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我曾以為那是應得的懲罰。
畢竟，當所有同志都犧牲了，為什麼只有我活了下來？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
It was then that I decided to avenge my friends, and salvage
what was left of my sense of honor.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
就在那時，我決定為朋友們復仇，並挽回我僅存的一點榮譽。

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
I went back to that place.
I fought and I fought, trying to make penance for what I had
done wrong...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
我回到了那個地方。
我不斷地戰鬥，試圖為我所犯下的錯誤贖罪...

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
That voice...
Isn't that...?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
那個聲音...
難道不是...？

scripts.text:
[Lowen Ellenen]
Are you giving me another chance? But I no longer have a body to fight monsters anymore...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫·艾萊南]
你是在給我第二次機會嗎？
但我已經沒有身體與魔物戰鬥了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry,
I'm with you!
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，我會陪在你身邊！
我們一起做吧！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You have passed
the test, Lowen.
I don't have much
time to speak.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
你通過了考驗，洛溫。
我沒有太多時間對話。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Have you found the strength to release yourself from the guilt and the pain? I have been waiting for you. Will you accept my invitation to Valhalla?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
你找到了從愧疚和痛苦中解脫的力量嗎？
我一直在等你。
你願意接受我前往瓦爾哈拉的邀請嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will follow you.
scripts.translation: 是的，我會跟隨你

scripts.text: Um... I'm not Lowen.
scripts.translation: 呃...我不是洛溫

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Lowen Ellenen, misunderstood hero. I will now promote you
to Einherjar with
the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
洛溫·艾萊南，被誤解的英雄。
我將以神的意志，晉升你為英靈戰士。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Your soul and spirit will be reborn in Valhalla as a holy warrior preparing for the holy war.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
你的靈魂與精神將在瓦爾哈拉重生，成為為聖戰做準備的神聖戰士。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
And...
{0},
Your exploits are known to me. But I am curious as to what has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
還有...
{0}，你的事蹟我已知曉。
但我很好奇，是什麼讓你來到了這裡？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explained what happened to the Valkyrie, starting from the Snow Crystal which never melts.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向瓦爾基里解釋了所發生的一切，從那顆永不融化的雪的結晶開始。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I understand.
The story begins a long, long time ago with Freya, the patron goddess of beauty and love.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
我明白了。
故事要從很久很久以前說起，始於美麗與愛之神芙蕾雅。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Her teardrop became a beautiful jewel. The snow on which Freya's teardrops have fallen will always retain its crystalline beauty.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
她的淚滴化作了美麗的寶石。
凡是被芙蕾雅淚滴觸及的雪花，都將永遠保留其結晶之美。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You seek traces of the goddess? Perhaps this is a sign of the end of the thousand year peace. When the time comes, I hope humans will not abandon their faith.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
你在尋找女神的痕跡嗎？
也許這是千年和平終結的徵兆。
當那一刻來臨時，我希望人類不會放棄他們的信仰。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Perhaps, I was also sent to meet you. I wish that humans will use the power derived from the traces of the gods to protect justice.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
也許，我來到你面前也是命中註定。
我希望人類能利用源自神蹟的力量，守護正義。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
{0}...
Listen. This is
what you must find.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
{0}...
聽著。
這是你必須找到的東西。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
A cold snowy path on
which the goddess tread.
A blue river the goddess crossed.
A narrow path the goddess passed.
Four dwarves that the goddess met...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
女神踏過的寒冷雪徑。
女神渡過的藍色河流。
女神經過的狹窄小徑。
女神遇見的四位矮人...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
^4d4dffThe beauty of the stars
Wanes in comparison.
We lost our hearts
To that golden hair
And those dazzling eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
^4d4dff星辰之美
也為之黯然失色。
我們的心
迷失在那金色的秀髮
與那雙耀眼的眼眸裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Remember this.
I shall send you
back to where you
belong.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
記住這些。
我會送你回到你該去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
For Odin's honor...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
為了奧丁的榮耀...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Hahahaha...
It has been
a while since
a mortal has
made me laugh.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
哈哈哈哈哈...
已經很久沒有凡人能讓我發笑了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
{0},
I am speaking to the
spirit that rests within you, the girl to whom you lent your body so that she may learn the truth of the past.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
{0}，我正在與你體內的靈魂對話，那個借你身體以瞭解過去真相的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Lowen Ellenen,
misunderstood hero.
I will now promote you to Einherjar with the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
洛溫·艾萊南，被誤解的英雄。
我將依神之意志，晉升你為英靈戰士。

{0}，你的事蹟我已知曉。

[Old dwarf]
Who are you?!
And why the hell
did you wake me up?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的矮人]
你是誰？！
你他媽的為什麼吵醒我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Nothing happened.
Did I do something wrong, or is this just a completely ordinary puzzle cube?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
什麼都沒發生。
是我做錯了什麼，還是這只是一個普通的魔方？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This...
This better not
be just some regular
puzzle cube that someone
just dropped in the snow!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...
這最好不是某人隨手丟在雪裡的普通魔方！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou use your finger to poke the pile of snow. However, you hurt your finger a little bit after hitting something really solid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用手指戳了戳那堆雪。然而，碰到某個堅硬的東西后，你的手指有點疼。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA lot of snow
is heavily piled
here on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡的地面上堆積著厚厚的積雪。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
I've got nothing
more to say! Now
get out of here!
I don't want to
be found!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我沒什麼好說的了！
現在滾出去！
我不想被找到！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
What's up, human?
All of us have awakened.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
怎麼了，人類？
我們都醒了。

scripts.text: I just wanted to say hello.
scripts.translation: 只是想打個招呼

scripts.text: What are Brisingamen's materials?
scripts.translation: 女神項鍊的材料是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Your gesture is appreciated, but I'd rather hide than socialize. I don't want to be found by the crows of Odin!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
感謝你的好意，但我寧願躲起來也不願社交。我不想被奧丁的烏鴉發現！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Materials for Brisingamen? For the human imitation, the materials are pretty easy to gather...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
女神項鍊的材料？對於人類仿製品來說，材料很容易收集...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
The power of weapons used by gods, when they battled demons a thousand years ago, and everything detached from Brisingamen. That's basically what you need.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
一千年前眾神與惡魔戰鬥時使用的武器之力，以及從女神項鍊上脫落的一切。基本上就是這些。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
If you want to
create a Brisingamen,
you will need.....
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
如果你想製作女神項鍊，你需要.....

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffFreya's Jewel
Silver Ornament
Snow Crystal
Ripple
Drifting Air^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
^4d4dff芙蕾雅寶石
銀飾品
雪的結晶
漣漪
空氣雕像^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
You might need some gems, like Saphire, Peal, Opal, Curse Ruby, and maybe even some Gold to decorate the necklace.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
你可能還需要一些寶石，比如藍寶石、珍珠、蛋白石、詛咒紅寶石，甚至可能還需要一些黃金來裝飾項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Although I give freely of my advice, we four Dwarves will no longer do smithing work unless it be Freya's command.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
雖然我樂意提供建議，但我們四個矮人除非奉芙蕾雅之命，否則不會再從事鍛造工作了。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
But I can promise you one thing. Since the four of us have awakened, humans will obtain the Brisingamen for sure.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
但我可以向你保證一件事。既然我們四人都已甦醒，人類必定能打造出女神項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Now...
Leave me
in peace.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
好了...
請讓我安靜一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's been a long time since I've been outside! W-wait! You're not...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
我已經很久沒到外面來了！等...等等！你不是...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Who sent you?!
Loki? Heimdall?
Or was it Freya?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
是誰派你來的？！
洛基？海姆達爾？
還是芙蕾雅？

scripts.text: No one, it was an accident!
scripts.translation: 沒人，純屬意外！

scripts.text: It was Valkyrie.
scripts.translation: 是瓦爾基里

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Don't even think of lying to me, human! There's no way you could have awoken me without knowing
the password! Now, speak!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
別想騙我，人類！沒有口令你根本不可能喚醒我！現在，說！

scripts.text: Valkyrie told me.
scripts.translation: 是瓦爾基里告訴我的

scripts.text: It was a coincidence!
scripts.translation: 純屬巧合！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Valkyrie...?
Odin's warmonger?
What could Odin want,
I haven't done anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
瓦爾基里...？
奧丁的戰爭狂人？
奧丁想幹什麼，我什麼都沒做錯啊！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explained everything to Alfrik, who seems to worry about being targeted by Odin.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向阿爾弗裡克解釋了一切，他似乎很擔心會被奧丁盯上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
So that's it.
Seeking out our
masterpiece? You
humans must desire
the power of the gods.
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
原來如此。
尋找我們的傑作？你們人類一定渴望神的力量。
有意思。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
The time for us to revive may actually have come! Alright then,
I, Alfrik shall cooperate with you humans.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我們復活的時刻可能真的到了！好吧，我，阿爾弗裡克，願意與你們人類合作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
After all, getting on Odin's good side like this is much better than being tortured by Loki.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
畢竟，像這樣討好奧丁，總比被洛基折磨要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Now...
Understand that
there can only be
one true Brisingamen.
After all, it's our
masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
現在...
你要明白，真正的女神項鍊只能有一條。
畢竟，那是我們的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
However, that doesn't mean an imitation, with the same power as that godly item, can't be made. Isn't it tempting, the power of a god?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
不過，這並不意味著無法制作出擁有同等神力的仿製品。神的力量，難道不誘人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
First things first. If you want to make the necklace, you must
awaken all four of us. Because of Loki's threat, we all hid ourselves in different places.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
首先，如果你想打造項鍊，必須喚醒我們四個人。因為洛基的威脅，我們各自藏身在不同的地方。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Go wake all my brothers!
Let's see if the Brisingamen can be made once again! First, go and wake Dvalin before the gods and giants find out!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
去喚醒我所有的兄弟！
讓我們看看女神項鍊能否再次被打造出來！首先，趕在眾神和巨人發現之前，先去喚醒德瓦林！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Coincidence?
Impossible! How dare you lie! Don't ever come back, or the gods will find me!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
巧合？
不可能！你竟敢撒謊！別再回來了，否則眾神會找到我的！

I haven't done anything wrong!

So that's it.
Seeking out our
masterpiece? You
humans must desire
the power of the gods.
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
原來如此。
尋找我們的傑作？你們人類一定渴望神的力量。
有意思。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
The time for us to revive may actually have come! Alright then,
I, Alfrik shall cooperate with you humans.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我們復活的時刻可能真的到了！好吧，我，阿爾弗裡克，願意與你們人類合作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
After all, getting on Odin's good side like this is much better than being tortured by Loki.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
畢竟，像這樣討好奧丁，總比被洛基折磨要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Now...
Understand that
there can only be
one true Brisingamen.
After all, it's our
masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
現在...
你要明白，真正的女神項鍊只能有一條。
畢竟，那是我們的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
However, that doesn't mean an imitation, with the same power as that godly item, can't be made. Isn't it tempting, the power of a god?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
不過，這並不意味著無法制作出擁有同等神力的仿製品。神的力量，難道不誘人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
First things first. If you want to make the necklace, you must
awaken all four of us. Because of Loki's threat, we all hid ourselves in different places.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
首先，如果你想打造項鍊，必須喚醒我們四個人。因為洛基的威脅，我們各自藏身在不同的地方。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Go wake all my brothers!
Let's see if the Brisingamen can be made once again! First, go and wake Dvalin before the gods and giants find out!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
去喚醒我所有的兄弟！
讓我們看看女神項鍊能否再次被打造出來！首先，趕在眾神和巨人發現之前，先去喚醒德瓦林！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Why are you still here?
I told you go wake Dvalin!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
你怎麼還在這裡？
我讓你去喚醒德瓦林！

scripts.text: Where is he?
scripts.translation: 他在哪裡？

scripts.text: Tell me more about Brisingamen.
scripts.translation: 多告訴我一些關於女神項鍊的事

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Ah. Right.
I forgot to tell
you. Poor Dvalin.
Now, where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
啊，對。
我忘了告訴你。
可憐的德瓦林。
嗯，他在哪裡來著？

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
We were afraid that Odin and Heimdall would punish us because, well, in their eyes we disgraced the goddess.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我們害怕奧丁和海姆達爾會懲罰我們，因為，嗯，在他們眼裡，我們讓女神蒙羞了。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Oh course, they never would have been angered if it weren't for Loki's trickery.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
當然，如果不是洛基的詭計，他們本來是不會生氣的。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
We loved Freya so much that we decided to hide ourselves beneath the path that she walked. To be as close to any trace of her as we could.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我們如此深愛芙蕾雅，以至於決定藏身在她走過的道路之下。為了儘可能靠近她留下的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Poor Dvalin is sleeping
under the path in the East. Once there, you'll feel the scent the goddess. I can't remember where the others are sleeping, but you cannot forget these words...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
可憐的德瓦林正睡在東邊的道路下面。到了那裡，你會聞到女神的氣息。我不記得其他人睡在哪裡了，但你不能忘記這些話...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffHer lovely scent
Still lingers in the wind.
We surrendered our hearts
To those tender teardrops
Those seductive red lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
^4d4dff她迷人的芬芳
仍在風中縈繞。
我們獻出了真心，
獻給那溫柔的淚滴，
獻給那誘人的紅唇。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Brisingamen is our masterpiece, a necklace we forged for Freya. Even if we tried making it again, I doubt it would be as good.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
女神項鍊是我們的傑作，是我們為芙蕾雅打造的項鍊。即使我們再次嘗試製作，恐怕也不會有原來那麼好。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
It looked perfect on Freya. Very difficult to create jewelry that actually enhances the attractiveness of the goddess of beauty.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
它戴在芙蕾雅身上完美無瑕。很難打造出能真正提升美麗女神魅力的珠寶。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Perhaps our greatest reward was that beautiful smile of satisfaction she gave us when that we gave her that necklace. We loved her so.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
也許我們最大的獎賞，就是當我們把項鍊送給她時，她露出的那抹滿足而美麗的微笑。我們如此愛她。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Is it that wrong for dwarves to love a goddess? Perhaps we were punished because the gods, even Odin, loved her as well.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
矮人愛上一位女神有什麼錯嗎？也許我們受到懲罰，是因為眾神，甚至奧丁，也愛著她。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
In any case, we've never seen the true Brisingamen again. But something very similar to it can be created...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
無論如何，我們再也沒見過真正的女神項鍊。但可以製作出非常相似的東西...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
You'll need materials that have been graced by the goddess' presense. Traces of the goddess in the earth, water and the wind.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
你需要那些被女神氣息眷顧的材料。女神在大地、水和風中留下的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
And if the Brisingamen is recreated, the power of a god will be in the hands of a human. That human could be you!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
如果女神項鍊被重新打造，神的力量將掌握在一個人類手中。那個人類可能就是你！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Poor Dvalin is sleeping under the path in the East. Once there, you'll feel the scent the goddess.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
可憐的德瓦林正睡在東邊的道路下面。到了那裡，你會聞到女神的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
I can't remember where the others are sleeping, but you cannot forget these words...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
我不記得其他人睡在哪裡了，但你不能忘記這些話...

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
^4d4dffHer lovely scent
Still lingers in the wind.
We surrendered our hearts
To those tender teardrops
Those seductive red lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
^4d4dff她迷人的芬芳
仍在風中縈繞。
我們獻出了真心，
獻給那溫柔的淚滴，
獻給那誘人的紅唇。^000000

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Will you please!
Get lost before Loki and Heimdall find out I've awakened! Now hurry, find Dvalin, and wake him up!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
求你了！
在洛基和海姆達爾發現我醒來之前快離開！快去吧，找到德瓦林，喚醒他！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Oh, finally all of us have awakened! Now, the power of the goddess can be retrieved from the earth, water and the wind!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
哦，終於，我們全都甦醒了！現在，女神的力量可以從大地、水和風中獲取了！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Hahahahaha!
This should be
interesting!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
哈哈哈哈！
這下有意思了！

scripts.text:
[Alfrik]
Mmm...?
I've got
no business
with you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾弗裡克]
嗯...？
我跟你沒什麼關係。

scripts.text:

ordinary rock.^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just an ordinary rock underneath the shadow of
a tree. But on closer inspection, you notice that the moss on top of the rock looks perfectly flat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這只是一塊樹蔭下的普通石頭。但仔細觀察，你會發現石頭上的苔蘚看起來非常平整。^000000

scripts.text: Step on it.
scripts.translation: 踩上去

scripts.text: Sweep the surface.
scripts.translation: 掃開表面

scripts.text: Scratch the surface.
scripts.translation: 刮擦表面

scripts.text: Kick it.
scripts.translation: 踢它

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly place your foot on the top of the stone. The entire rock suddenly swings downward
into the ground, and you fall helplessly...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地踩在石頭上。整塊石頭突然向下沉入地面，你無助地掉了下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAs you sweep away the moss with your hand, you scratch your palm from the sharp edges of the rock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當你用手掃開苔蘚時，手掌被石頭鋒利的邊緣劃傷了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn...!
I'm bleeding!
But why didn't
anything else
happen?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死...！
我流血了！
但為什麼沒有發生其他事情？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This rock had
better be one of
those secret rocks!
Or else...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這塊石頭最好是一塊秘密石頭！
否則...！

scripts.text:

at the moss, and feel that the surface of the rock has even recesses.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你刮開苔蘚，感覺到石頭表面有凹陷。

scripts.translation: ^3355FF剝掉苔蘚後，石頭頂部露出了一系列刻有淡淡文字的瓷磚。這些瓷磚可以像拼圖一樣移動。^000000

scripts.text:

...?
Alfrik?
Is that you?

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
A human?
You woke me up?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
人類？
是你吵醒我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Hmm...
And you'd be acting pretty pushy right about now if you were acting on behalf of a god. What could you want...?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
嗯...
如果你代表某位神明，現在應該會很強勢才對。你想要什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
It makes sense that you want a replica of Brisingamen for its power. But remember, we originally made Brisingamen as a necklace fit for a goddess.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
想要複製品是為了它的力量，這說得通。但請記住，我們最初製作女神項鍊，是為了獻給女神。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Some might say that we seduced Freya with the necklace, but we really loved her with all of our hearts.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
也許有人會說我們用項鍊誘惑了芙蕾雅，但我們其實是全心全意愛著她的。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Wah, it's not Alfrik?
Who are you to wake Dvalin?
Tell me right now, or I'll...
I'll kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
哇，不是阿爾弗裡克？
你算哪根蔥，敢吵醒德瓦林？
現在就說，不然...
不然我就揍扁你！

scripts.text: Help!
scripts.translation: 救命！

scripts.text: Alfrik sent me to wake you up!
scripts.translation: 是阿爾弗裡克派我來叫醒你的！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
I don't know
what the hell
you're doing here,
but leave!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
我不知道你在這裡搞什麼鬼，但給我滾！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Did you just say Alfrik sent you? How do you know my brother?!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
你剛才說阿爾弗裡克派你來的？你怎麼認識我哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Brisingamen?!
Then, that means
we can meet Freya again?!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
女神項鍊？！
那麼，我們就能再見到芙蕾雅了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm...
I'm afraid not.
Or, at least, that's
not why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
恐怕不是。
至少，這不是我來的原因。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Okay...
I understand.
Sorry, I was just
hoping you were a
herald of Freya.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
好吧...
我明白了。
抱歉，我只是希望你是芙蕾雅的使者。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
So, an imitation
of Brisingamen...
Even if it's not the original, I'm sure it can possess power comparable to the real thing. Yes...
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
所以，是女神項鍊的仿製品...
即使不是原件，我相信它也能擁有與真品相當的力量。是的...

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
It's no use trying to predict the future, but I can't help but wonder what would mankind do with the power of the gods?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
試圖預測未來是沒有用的，但我忍不住想知道，人類會如何利用神的力量？

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
If my brother Alfrik already approved of you, then I'll help you out. I'll tell you how to wake my brother Berling.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
既然我哥哥阿爾弗裡克已經認可了你，那我會幫你的。我會告訴你如何喚醒我哥哥貝林。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
We hid ourselves near traces of Freya. The path where I am staying is one that my goddess has walked through.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
我們隱藏在芙蕾雅留下的痕跡附近。我居住的地方，是女神曾經走過的路。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
The air that quietly drifts here holds her fragrant scent. You can use this wind to borrow her power.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
這裡靜靜飄浮的空氣裡，帶著她芬芳的氣息。
你可以藉助這風，借用她的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Aside from Freya, I have
no special love for the gods or giants. But I am intrigued by you humans. Your race is one of both love and hatred, life and destruction.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
除了芙蕾雅，我對其他的神或巨人並沒有特別的感情。
但我對人類很感興趣。
你們這個種族，既充滿愛與恨，也兼具生與滅。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Go now and seek Berling. He is sleeping near a river linked to Mount Mjolnir. Travel West to find the river were Freya's Teardrops have fallen.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
去吧，去找貝林。
他正睡在雷神之錘山附近的一條河邊。
往西走，找到那條落有芙蕾雅之淚的河流。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
If the phantom of water gives you a question, answer it. The answer is the punishment that Odin gave to our goddess.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
如果水的幻影向你提問，請回答它。
那個答案，就是奧丁賜予我們女神的懲罰。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Until thousands of Valkyries filled up Valhala, they had to repeatedly live, die, then be reborn the next day only to die again.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
直到成千上萬的瓦爾基里填滿瓦爾哈拉，她們不得不反覆經歷生與死，第二天重生，卻又再次死去。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Think about
who they were.
That's all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
想想她們是誰。
我只能告訴你這些。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Somehow, I know
you are the one who
can answer the question.
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
不知為何，我知道你就是那個能回答這個問題的人。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
Why do you keep calling me? I did everything I can do for you. I even gave you the key to the question.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
你為什麼一直叫我？
我已經為你做了一切。
我甚至給了你問題的鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Dvalin]
From now on,
it's all up to you.
Now, go wake Berling...
scripts.translation:
[德瓦林]
從現在開始，一切由你自己決定。
現在，去喚醒貝林...

scripts.text:
[Berling]

[貝林]
是你喚醒了我們？哈哈，這或許是個好兆頭，我們又能見到芙蕾雅了！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Berling]
We are indebted to you for reviving us. Okay, I know what you want, and will help you obtain the power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
我們要感謝你將我們復活。好吧，我知道你想要什麼，我會幫你獲得神的力量。

scripts.text:

scripts.text: Dvalin wants you to wake up!

scripts.text: Tell me who you are first!

[Berling]

scripts.translation:
[貝林]
哦！再叫一次那個名字！奪走我身體和靈魂的芙蕾雅！你剛才說想打造她的項鍊？

scripts.text:
[Berling]

Stop joking around.
The Brisingamen is
a one of a kind
masterpiece!
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
哈哈哈！
別開玩笑了。
女神項鍊是獨一無二的傑作！

scripts.text: I don't mean the original one, but...
scripts.translation: 我不是指原本的那條，而是...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Ah, now I see! You want a replica that has roughly the same power.
A Brisingamen used by humans!
Very clever!
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
啊，我明白了！你想要一個擁有大致相同力量的複製品。
供人類使用的女神項鍊！
真是聰明！

scripts.text:
[Berling]
I, on the other hand, do not desire power. I would be happy to own but a strand of my goddess' hair.
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
而我，並不渴望力量。如果能擁有一縷女神的頭髮，我就心滿意足了。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Oh Freya...
The more of her beauty exists in this world, the happier I'll be. I'm more than willing to help you recreate this memento of Freya.
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
芙蕾雅...
這世上多一分她的美麗，我就多一分快樂。我非常樂意幫你重現這件芙蕾雅的遺物。

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Now, please go and find the last one of my brothers! Poor Grer, perhaps he is still digging silver in that mine for her...
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
現在，請去找我兄弟中的最後一位吧！可憐的格雷爾，也許他還在礦裡為她挖銀礦...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
Go and find Grer. I will give you Freya's golden teardrop, but he might have revived on his own...
scripts.translation:
[貝林]
去找格雷爾吧。我會給你芙蕾雅的金色淚滴，但他可能已經自己復活了...

scripts.text:
[Berling]
If he doesn't trust you, sing this song. You must remember each
and every word...

如果他不信任你，就唱這首歌。你必須記住每一個字...

the last one to be awakened. Now I see that I haven't mined as much silver as I may need.

scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
你可能覺得黃金更適合女神，但不對。銀才能讓她的金色頭髮更加美麗。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now that we're revived, there's a good chance that we may see her again. I don't really mind anything else.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
既然我們復活了，就有機會再次見到她。其他的事我都不在意。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
I want her spirit and scent to fill this world. I don't want Odin or Heimdall to know our plan.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
我要讓她的靈魂和氣息充滿這個世界。我不希望奧丁或海姆達爾知道我們的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now, this doesn't mean
that I prefer humans over
gods or giants, but if it's for Freya, I'll do anything.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
現在，這並不意味著我比神或巨人更偏愛人類，但如果是為了芙蕾雅，我會做任何事。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Anyway, now my brothers
have been revived. For that, I give you my thanks. Someday, you will have the power to challenge the gods.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
總之，現在我的兄弟們已經復活了。為此，我感謝你們。總有一天，你們將擁有挑戰諸神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Now, I need to
get back to my work.
You'll need a silver ornament for the necklace, so I'll continue to mine silver.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
現在，我需要回去工作了。
項鍊需要銀飾品，所以我會繼續挖銀礦。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
I will be working
hard to make the most
beautiful ornament
in the world.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
我會努力工作，製作出世界上最美麗的飾品。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Okay, you
may go back now!
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
好了，你可以回去了！
再見。

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Heh heh...
Why are you still
here? Your job is done.
Now, go back to where
you came from!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
嘿嘿...
你為什麼還在這裡？你的任務已經完成了。
現在，回到你來的地方去！

scripts.text:
[Grer]
Who the
hell are you?!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爾]
你他媽的是誰？！
